<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head><script>(function () {
  ['pushState', 'replaceState'].forEach(function (method) {
    var original = history[method];
    history[method] = function () {
      try { return original.apply(history, arguments); } catch (e) { /* opaque origin, ignore */ }
    };
  });
})();</script>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Bored Chat</title>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<!-- Firebase (compat SDK) -->
<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.13.0/firebase-app-compat.js"></script>
<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.13.0/firebase-auth-compat.js"></script>
<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.13.0/firebase-database-compat.js"></script>


<style>
  :root{
    --bg-rail:#1e1f22;--bg-list:#2b2d31;--bg-chat:#313338;--bg-input:#383a40;--bg-hover:#3a3c43;
    --blurple:#5865f2;--blurple-hover:#4752c4;--online:#23a55a;--danger:#f23f42;--danger-hover:#da373c;--gold:#f0b232;
    --text-bright:#f2f3f5;--text-normal:#dbdee1;--text-muted:#949ba4;--text-faint:#6a6e77;--border:#232428;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;height:100%;background:var(--bg-rail);font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;color:var(--text-normal);overflow:hidden;}
  #app{position:relative;width:100%;height:100vh;overflow:hidden;}
  ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px;height:8px;}
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent;}
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#1a1b1e;border-radius:4px;}

  #authScreen{position:relative;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;text-align:center;padding:20px;
    background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%, #3a3d6b 0%, transparent 45%),radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, #2a2140 0%, transparent 50%),var(--bg-rail);}
  .logo-mark{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--blurple);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.7rem;font-weight:700;color:#fff;margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(88,101,242,0.4);}
  .logo-word{font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-bright);letter-spacing:-0.5px;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .tagline{color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:30px;font-size:0.92rem;}
  .auth-card{width:100%;max-width:380px;background:var(--bg-chat);border-radius:8px;padding:32px 28px;box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);}
  .tabs{display:flex;margin-bottom:20px;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg-input);}
  .tab-btn{flex:1;padding:9px 0;background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-muted);font-family:'Inter';font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.84rem;transition:all .15s;}
  .tab-btn.active{background:var(--blurple);color:#fff;}
  .field{margin-bottom:16px;text-align:left;}
  .field label{display:block;font-size:0.72rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.3px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:7px;}
  .field input{width:100%;padding:10px 11px;border-radius:4px;background:#1e1f22;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-normal);font-size:0.95rem;outline:none;transition:border .15s;}
  .field input:focus{border-color:var(--blurple);}
  .field input[type=color]{height:38px;padding:2px;cursor:pointer;}
  .primary-btn{width:100%;padding:11px;border:none;border-radius:4px;background:var(--blurple);color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:0.92rem;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s;margin-top:6px;}
  .primary-btn:hover{background:var(--blurple-hover);}
  .primary-btn:disabled{opacity:0.55;cursor:not-allowed;}
  .ghost-btn{width:100%;padding:10px;border-radius:4px;margin-top:8px;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-muted);font-weight:600;font-size:0.85rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;}
  .ghost-btn:hover{border-color:var(--text-muted);color:var(--text-normal);}
  .auth-msg{min-height:18px;font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--danger);margin-top:10px;word-break:break-word;text-align:left;}

  .yt-banner{margin-top:24px;max-width:380px;width:100%;background:var(--bg-chat);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:13px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--text-normal);transition:border-color .15s;}
  .yt-banner:hover{border-color:var(--danger);}
  .yt-icon{width:32px;height:32px;flex:0 0 auto;border-radius:8px;background:var(--danger);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
  .yt-icon svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:#fff;}
  .yt-text{text-align:left;line-height:1.3;}
  .yt-text b{font-size:0.86rem;}
  .yt-text span{font-size:0.74rem;color:var(--text-muted);}

  #chatScreen{position:relative;height:100%;display:none;flex-direction:row;}

  .avatar{border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;color:#fff;overflow:hidden;background:var(--blurple);}
  .avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
  .avatar-xs{width:20px;height:20px;font-size:0.6rem;}
  .avatar-sm{width:32px;height:32px;font-size:0.8rem;}
  .avatar-md{width:40px;height:40px;font-size:0.9rem;}
  .presence-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 auto;border:3px solid var(--bg-list);background:var(--text-faint);margin-left:-12px;margin-top:14px;}
  .presence-dot.online{background:var(--online);}

  /* server rail */
  #serverRail{width:72px;flex:0 0 auto;background:var(--bg-rail);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:12px 0;gap:8px;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;}
  .rail-icon{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg-list);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.3rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;color:var(--text-normal);position:relative;overflow:hidden;flex:0 0 auto;font-weight:700;}
  .rail-icon img{pointer-events:none;}
  .rail-icon:hover, .rail-icon.active{border-radius:16px;background:var(--blurple);color:#fff;}
  .rail-icon.active::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-12px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:4px;height:24px;background:#fff;border-radius:0 4px 4px 0;}
  .rail-divider{width:32px;height:2px;background:var(--border);border-radius:1px;margin:2px 0;flex:0 0 auto;}
  #serverRailList, #pinnedRailList{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;align-items:center;}
  .rail-add{color:var(--online);font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:400;}
  .rail-add:hover{background:var(--online);color:#fff;}
  .rail-icon.pin-friend{background:transparent;}
  .rail-icon.pin-friend .avatar{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;border-radius:0;font-size:1.1rem;}
  .rail-pres{position:absolute;right:1px;bottom:1px;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid var(--bg-rail);background:var(--text-faint);}
  .rail-pres.online{background:var(--online);}

  /* channel column */
  #chanCol{width:240px;flex:0 0 auto;background:var(--bg-list);display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;}
  #chanColHeader{padding:14px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-weight:700;color:var(--text-bright);font-size:0.98rem;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.15);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
  #chanColBanner{display:none;height:104px;flex:0 0 auto;background-size:cover;background-position:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);align-items:flex-end;padding:10px 14px;}
  #chanColBanner .banner-name{color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:1.02rem;text-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.7);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
  .upload-row{margin:-6px 0 14px;font-size:0.74rem;color:var(--text-muted);}
  .upload-row input[type=file]{width:100%;font-size:0.74rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:4px;}
  #chanColDesc{display:none;padding:8px 16px;font-size:0.74rem;color:var(--text-muted);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);line-height:1.4;word-break:break-word;}

  .voice-status-bar{display:none;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 12px;background:#292b2f;font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--online);margin:0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);}
  .voice-status-bar.show{display:flex;}
  .voice-status-bar span.vname{flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
  .voice-status-bar button{background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(242,63,66,0.4);color:var(--danger);border-radius:4px;font-size:0.68rem;padding:3px 7px;cursor:pointer;}

  .sidebar-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:10px 8px 6px;}
  .sidebar-tab-btn{flex:1;padding:7px 0;border-radius:4px;border:none;background:transparent;color:var(--text-muted);font-weight:600;font-size:0.76rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;letter-spacing:0.2px;}
  .sidebar-tab-btn.active{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-bright);}
  .sidebar-tab-btn .badge-dot{display:inline-block;min-width:16px;height:16px;line-height:16px;background:var(--danger);color:#fff;border-radius:8px;font-size:0.62rem;margin-left:4px;padding:0 4px;}

  .sidebar-section-title{font-size:0.68rem;letter-spacing:0.4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-muted);margin:14px 0 4px;padding:0 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:700;}
  .new-group-btn{background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:1rem;cursor:pointer;transition:color .15s;line-height:1;}
  .new-group-btn:hover{color:var(--text-bright);}
  .add-friend-row{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:0 8px;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .add-friend-row input{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:4px;background:#1e1f22;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-normal);font-size:0.8rem;outline:none;font-family:'Inter';}
  .add-friend-row input:focus{border-color:var(--blurple);}
  .add-friend-row button{border:none;border-radius:4px;padding:0 12px;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.76rem;font-weight:600;background:var(--blurple);color:#fff;}
  .add-friend-row button:hover{background:var(--blurple-hover);}
  .add-friend-msg{font-size:0.72rem;min-height:16px;margin:2px 12px 6px;color:var(--danger);}
  .add-friend-msg.ok{color:var(--online);}

  #panelScroll{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding-bottom:10px;}
  .empty-list-note{color:var(--text-faint);font-size:0.76rem;padding:10px 14px;text-align:center;}

  .list-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:7px 8px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.86rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:all .1s;margin:1px 8px;}
  .list-item:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-normal);}
  .list-item.active{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-bright);}
  .list-item .item-name{flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
  .list-item .hash{opacity:0.55;font-weight:600;}
  .list-item .mini-btn{opacity:0;background:transparent;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.82rem;padding:0 3px;line-height:1;}
  .list-item:hover .mini-btn{opacity:0.85;}
  .list-item .mini-btn.call{color:var(--online);}
  .list-item .mini-btn.video{color:var(--blurple);}
  .list-item .mini-btn.del, .list-item .mini-btn.block{color:var(--danger);}
  .list-item .mini-btn.nick, .list-item .mini-btn.pin{color:var(--gold);}
  .list-item .mini-btn.invite{color:var(--blurple);}
  .list-item .mini-btn.addppl{color:var(--online);}
  .list-item .mini-btn.leave{color:var(--gold);}
  .list-item .voice-count{font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--online);white-space:nowrap;}

  .request-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:0.82rem;background:var(--bg-chat);margin:0 8px 6px;}
  .request-row .req-name{flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--text-normal);}
  .request-row button{border:none;border-radius:4px;padding:5px 9px;font-size:0.72rem;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;}
  .req-accept{background:var(--online);color:#fff;}
  .req-decline, .req-cancel, .req-unblock{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-muted);}
  .req-decline:hover, .req-cancel:hover{border-color:var(--danger);color:var(--danger);}
  .req-unblock:hover{border-color:var(--online);color:var(--online);}

  #userBar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 8px;background:#232428;flex:0 0 auto;}
  #userBar .user-block{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex:1;min-width:0;cursor:pointer;padding:4px;border-radius:4px;}
  #userBar .user-block:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);}
  #userBar .user-info{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;}
  #userBar .user-info b{font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--text-bright);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;max-width:110px;}
  #userBar .user-info span{font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-muted);}
  #userBar .bar-icon-btn{background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:1rem;cursor:pointer;padding:6px;border-radius:4px;}
  #userBar .bar-icon-btn:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-bright);}

  #chatMain{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;background:var(--bg-chat);}
  .chat-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.1);}
  .chat-header .header-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:0;}
  .sidebar-toggle-btn{display:none;background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-muted);padding:6px;cursor:pointer;font-size:1.1rem;}
  .current-chat-label-wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;}
  .current-chat-label{font-size:0.98rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-bright);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
  .current-chat-sub{font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--text-muted);white-space:nowrap;}
  .header-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .call-header-btn{background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-muted);padding:6px;border-radius:4px;font-size:1.05rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;}
  .call-header-btn:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--online);}
  .call-header-btn.video:hover{color:var(--blurple);}
  .chan-action-btn{background:var(--bg-input);border:none;color:var(--text-normal);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:4px;font-size:0.76rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;}
  .chan-action-btn:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-bright);}
  .chan-action-btn.warn:hover{color:var(--gold);}
  .my-profile-btn{background:none;border:none;padding:0;cursor:pointer;display:none;}
  .admin-badge{background:#ffd60a;color:#1e1f22;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:4px;font-size:0.7rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.4px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,214,10,0.4);}
  .conn-pill{padding:5px 10px;border-radius:4px;font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-muted);background:var(--bg-input);}
  .conn-pill.online{color:var(--online);}
  .conn-pill.offline{color:var(--danger);}

  .promo-strip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:rgba(88,101,242,0.08);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:8px 16px;font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--text-muted);flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .promo-strip a{color:#a6b1ff;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;}
  .promo-strip a:hover{text-decoration:underline;}

  .voice-panel{display:none;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);background:#2b2d31;}
  .voice-panel.show{display:flex;}
  .voice-panel .voice-join-btn{border:none;border-radius:4px;padding:7px 14px;font-size:0.8rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;background:var(--online);color:#fff;}
  .voice-panel .voice-join-btn.leave{background:var(--danger);}
  .voice-chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:var(--bg-input);border-radius:16px;padding:4px 10px 4px 4px;font-size:0.76rem;color:var(--text-normal);}

  #messages{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:12px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;}
  .msg{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;max-width:100%;}
  .msg:hover{background:rgba(4,4,5,0.15);}
  .msg .avatar-slot{flex:0 0 auto;width:40px;padding-top:2px;}
  .msg .msg-body{flex:1;min-width:0;}
  .msg .name-row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;margin-bottom:2px;}
  .msg .name-row .who{font-weight:600;font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--text-bright);}
  .msg .name-row .when{font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-faint);}
  .msg .bubble{font-size:0.92rem;line-height:1.4;word-wrap:break-word;white-space:pre-wrap;color:var(--text-normal);}
  .msg.me .name-row .who{color:#a6b1ff;}
  .msg-actions{display:none;gap:2px;margin-left:auto;padding-top:2px;}
  .msg:hover .msg-actions{display:flex;}
  .msg-del-btn, .msg-block-btn{background:var(--bg-input);border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.78rem;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);}
  .msg-del-btn:hover{color:var(--danger);}
  .msg-block-btn:hover{color:var(--text-bright);}

  #typingBar{min-height:22px;padding:0 16px;font-size:0.76rem;color:var(--text-muted);font-style:italic;}
  #composer{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:0 16px 20px;align-items:center;}
  #attachBtn{flex:0 0 auto;background:var(--bg-input);border:none;color:var(--text-muted);width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;font-size:1.05rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;}
  #attachBtn:hover{color:var(--text-bright);background:var(--bg-hover);}
  .msg-media{max-width:320px;max-height:280px;border-radius:8px;margin-top:6px;display:block;cursor:pointer;}
  .media-blocked{margin-top:6px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg-input);color:var(--text-muted);font-size:0.8rem;max-width:320px;}
  .owner-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;background:#ffd60a;color:#1e1f22;font-size:0.62rem;font-weight:700;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:0.2px;vertical-align:middle;}
  .muted-tag{font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-faint);}
  .mini-btn.mute{color:var(--gold);}
  .mini-btn.ban{color:var(--danger);}
  #msgInputWrap{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;background:var(--bg-input);border-radius:8px;padding:0 12px;}
  #msgInput{flex:1;padding:12px 8px;background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-normal);font-size:0.94rem;outline:none;font-family:'Inter';}
  #sendBtn{padding:0 16px;border:none;background:transparent;color:var(--blurple);font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.85rem;}
  #sendBtn:hover{color:var(--blurple-hover);}
  #sendBtn:disabled{opacity:0.4;cursor:not-allowed;}
  .empty-state{text-align:center;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:60px;font-size:0.9rem;}
  .empty-state .glyph{font-size:2.4rem;display:block;margin-bottom:12px;opacity:0.5;}
  .composer-note{padding:0 16px 14px;font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--gold);}

  .modal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.72);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;}
  .modal-overlay.open{display:flex;}
  .modal-card{width:100%;max-width:360px;background:var(--bg-chat);border-radius:8px;padding:24px 22px;box-shadow:0 12px 44px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);text-align:left;max-height:88vh;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
  .modal-card h3{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--text-bright);}
  .modal-card p.sub{margin:0 0 16px;font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--text-muted);}
  .modal-card input[type=text]{width:100%;padding:10px 11px;border-radius:4px;background:#1e1f22;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-normal);font-size:0.95rem;outline:none;margin-bottom:12px;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .modal-card input[type=text]:focus{border-color:var(--blurple);}
  .modal-card .field{flex:0 0 auto;}
  .modal-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:4px;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .modal-actions button{flex:1;}
  .modal-err{min-height:16px;font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--danger);margin:-4px 0 10px;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .modal-err.ok{color:var(--online);}
  .member-picker{overflow-y:auto;flex:1;margin-bottom:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:8px 0;min-height:60px;}
  .member-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:7px 4px;font-size:0.86rem;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text-normal);}
  .member-row input{width:auto;margin:0;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .member-row span{flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
  .member-row .mini-btn{background:transparent;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.82rem;padding:0 4px;line-height:1;color:var(--danger);}
  .inline-row{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .inline-row input{margin-bottom:0!important;}
  .inline-row button{border:none;border-radius:4px;background:var(--blurple);color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:0.8rem;padding:10px 14px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;}
  .inline-row button:hover{background:var(--blurple-hover);}
  .type-choice{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .type-choice button{flex:1;padding:9px 6px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:transparent;color:var(--text-muted);font-weight:600;font-size:0.78rem;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Inter';}
  .type-choice button.active{background:var(--blurple);border-color:var(--blurple);color:#fff;}
  .code-box{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:1.5rem;letter-spacing:4px;text-align:center;background:#1e1f22;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:16px;color:var(--text-bright);margin-bottom:12px;user-select:all;}
  .modal-note{font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--text-faint);margin:0 0 12px;}

  .search-btn{background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-muted);padding:6px;border-radius:4px;font-size:1.05rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;}
  .search-btn:hover, .search-btn.active{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-bright);}
  #searchBar{display:none;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg-input);}
  #searchBar.open{display:flex;}
  #searchInput{flex:1;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:4px;background:#1e1f22;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-normal);font-size:0.86rem;outline:none;font-family:'Inter';}
  #searchInput:focus{border-color:var(--blurple);}
  #searchCount{font-size:0.74rem;color:var(--text-muted);white-space:nowrap;min-width:56px;text-align:right;}
  .search-close-btn{background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-muted);cursor:pointer;font-size:1rem;padding:2px 4px;}
  .search-close-btn:hover{color:var(--danger);}
  mark.hl{background:rgba(240,178,50,0.4);color:inherit;border-radius:2px;padding:0 1px;}
  .msg.dimmed{opacity:0.28;}

  .call-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:30;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.9);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;text-align:center;padding:24px;}
  .call-overlay.open{display:flex;}
  .call-avatar{width:100px;height:100px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blurple);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:2.2rem;color:#fff;animation:pulseRing 1.6s ease-out infinite;margin-bottom:18px;}
  @keyframes pulseRing{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(88,101,242,0.55);}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 28px rgba(88,101,242,0);}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(88,101,242,0);}}
  .call-peer-name{font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-bright);margin-bottom:4px;}
  .call-status-text{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:0.9rem;margin-bottom:28px;}
  .call-btn-row{display:flex;gap:22px;}
  .round-btn{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;border:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.4rem;transition:transform .15s;}
  .round-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .round-btn.accept{background:var(--online);color:#fff;}
  .round-btn.decline, .round-btn.hangup{background:var(--danger);color:#fff;}
  .round-btn.mute, .round-btn.vidtoggle, .round-btn.sharetoggle{background:var(--bg-input);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-normal);}
  .round-btn.mute.active{background:var(--danger);color:#fff;}
  .round-btn.vidtoggle.active{background:var(--blurple);color:#fff;}
  .round-btn.sharetoggle.active{background:var(--online);color:#fff;}

  #inCallOverlay{justify-content:flex-end;}
  .in-call-videos{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:640px;flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
  #remoteVideoEl{width:100%;max-height:60vh;border-radius:12px;background:#1e1f22;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid var(--border);}
  #localVideoEl{position:absolute;bottom:12px;right:12px;width:110px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:#1e1f22;object-fit:cover;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);}
  .in-call-audio-mode #remoteVideoEl, .in-call-audio-mode #localVideoEl{display:none;}
  .call-timer{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:0.82rem;margin:14px 0 18px;}

  .call-overlay.docked{position:fixed;inset:auto;left:auto;right:16px;bottom:16px;top:auto;width:280px;max-width:calc(100vw - 32px);height:auto;background:var(--bg-chat);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);padding:14px;z-index:25;}
  .call-overlay.docked .in-call-videos{max-width:100%;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .call-overlay.docked #remoteVideoEl{max-height:150px;}
  .call-overlay.docked #localVideoEl{width:64px;bottom:8px;right:8px;}
  .call-overlay.docked .call-avatar{width:56px;height:56px;font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .call-overlay.docked .call-peer-name{font-size:0.92rem;margin-bottom:0;}
  .call-overlay.docked .call-timer{font-size:0.72rem;margin:2px 0 10px;}
  .call-overlay.docked .call-btn-row{gap:10px;}
  .call-overlay.docked .round-btn{width:42px;height:42px;font-size:1.05rem;}
  .dock-toggle-btn{position:absolute;top:8px;right:8px;background:var(--bg-input);border:none;color:var(--text-muted);width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.85rem;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:1;}
  .dock-toggle-btn:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-bright);}
  #inCallOverlay.open{ pointer-events:none; }
  #inCallOverlay.open > *{ pointer-events:auto; }
  #inCallOverlay:not(.docked){ background:rgba(0,0,0,0.9); }
  #inCallOverlay.docked{ background:transparent; }

  #onlineCol{width:220px;flex:0 0 auto;background:var(--bg-list);border-left:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;}
  #onlineColHeader, #serverMembersHeader{padding:16px 16px 8px;font-size:0.68rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-muted);}
  #onlineColScroll, #serverMembersScroll{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:0 8px 12px;}
  .online-section{flex:1 1 0;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
  #serverMembersSection{border-top:1px solid var(--border);}
  .mdot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .mdot.on{background:var(--online);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(35,165,90,.7);}
  .mdot.off{background:var(--danger);}
  .online-item.offline .item-name{opacity:.6;}
  .online-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--text-normal);margin-bottom:1px;position:relative;}
  .online-item:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);}
  .online-item .item-name{flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
  .online-item .you-tag{font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-faint);}
  .online-empty-note{color:var(--text-faint);font-size:0.78rem;padding:10px 8px;text-align:center;}

  .tutorial-btn{background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-muted);padding:6px;border-radius:4px;font-size:1.05rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;}
  .tutorial-btn:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-bright);}
  #tutorialModal .modal-card{max-width:440px;}
  .tut-step{display:none;}
  .tut-step.active{display:block;}
  .tut-step h4{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--text-bright);font-size:1.02rem;}
  .tut-step p{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:0.86rem;color:var(--text-normal);line-height:1.5;}
  .tut-step .tut-glyph{font-size:1.8rem;margin-bottom:8px;display:block;}
  .tut-dots{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:center;margin:4px 0 14px;}
  .tut-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--border);cursor:pointer;}
  .tut-dot.active{background:var(--blurple);}
  .tut-nav-row{display:flex;gap:10px;}
  .tut-skip-row{text-align:center;margin-top:8px;}
  .tut-skip-row button{background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-faint);font-size:0.76rem;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;}

  #chanColHeader{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
  .notify-btn{background:transparent;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:1.05rem;padding:0;line-height:1;}
  .unread-badge{background:var(--danger);color:#fff;border-radius:8px;font-size:0.62rem;min-width:16px;height:16px;line-height:16px;text-align:center;padding:0 4px;font-weight:700;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .rail-badge{position:absolute;right:2px;top:2px;background:var(--danger);color:#fff;border-radius:9px;font-size:0.62rem;min-width:17px;height:17px;line-height:17px;text-align:center;padding:0 4px;font-weight:700;border:2px solid var(--bg-rail);box-sizing:content-box;}
  #toastHost{position:fixed;top:14px;right:14px;z-index:50;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;pointer-events:none;}
  .toast{pointer-events:auto;cursor:pointer;width:300px;max-width:calc(100vw - 28px);background:var(--bg-list);border:1px solid var(--border);border-left:4px solid var(--blurple);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.5);animation:toastIn .2s ease;}
  .toast b{display:block;font-size:0.84rem;color:var(--text-bright);margin-bottom:2px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
  .toast span{display:block;font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--text-normal);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
  @keyframes toastIn{from{transform:translateX(30px);opacity:0;}to{transform:none;opacity:1;}}
  .members-toggle-btn{display:none;background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-muted);padding:6px;border-radius:4px;font-size:1.05rem;cursor:pointer;}
  .members-toggle-btn:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-bright);}
  @media (max-width: 860px){
    #onlineCol{display:none;}
    #onlineCol.mobile-open{display:flex;position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:240px;z-index:9;box-shadow:-8px 0 28px rgba(0,0,0,.5);}
    .members-toggle-btn{display:inline-flex;}
  }
  @media (max-width: 720px){
    #serverRail{width:56px;}
    .rail-icon{width:42px;height:42px;}
    #chanCol{position:fixed;top:0;left:56px;bottom:0;width:250px;z-index:8;transform:translateX(calc(-100% - 56px));transition:transform .2s ease;}
    #chanCol.mobile-open{transform:translateX(0);}
    .sidebar-toggle-btn{display:inline-flex;}
    .my-profile-btn{display:inline-flex;}
    .list-item .mini-btn{opacity:0.7;}
    .call-overlay.docked{right:10px;bottom:10px;width:220px;}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app">

  <!-- AUTH SCREEN -->
  <div id="authScreen">
    <div class="logo-mark">B</div>
    <div class="logo-word">Bored Chat</div>
    <div class="tagline">Where your crew hangs out.</div>
    <div class="auth-card">
      <div class="tabs">
        <button class="tab-btn active" id="tabLogin" onclick="switchTab('login')">Log In</button>
        <button class="tab-btn" id="tabRegister" onclick="switchTab('register')">Create Account</button>
      </div>
      <div id="authForm">
        <div class="field"><label>Username</label><input type="text" id="usernameInput" autocomplete="username" maxlength="20" placeholder="e.g. nightowl" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')handleAuthSubmit(event)"></div>
        <div class="field"><label>Password</label><input type="password" id="passwordInput" autocomplete="current-password" placeholder="••••••••" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')handleAuthSubmit(event)"></div>
        <button type="button" class="primary-btn" id="submitBtn" onclick="handleAuthSubmit(event)">Continue</button>
        <div class="auth-msg" id="authMsg"></div>
      </div>
      <button class="ghost-btn" onclick="openTutorial()" type="button">📖 How does this work?</button>
    </div>
    <a class="yt-banner" href="https://www.youtube.com/@ShadowDefender2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
      <span class="yt-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"></path></svg></span>
      <span class="yt-text"><b>Subscribe to ShadowDefender2</b><br><span>on YouTube — join the crew 🔔</span></span>
    </a>
  </div>

  <!-- CHAT SCREEN -->
  <div id="chatScreen">

    <div id="serverRail">
      <div class="rail-icon active" id="railHome" title="Home" onclick="goHome()">B</div>
      <div class="rail-divider" id="pinnedDivider" style="display:none;"></div>
      <div id="pinnedRailList"></div>
      <div class="rail-divider"></div>
      <div id="serverRailList"></div>
      <div class="rail-icon rail-add" title="Add a server" onclick="openServerModal()">+</div>
    </div>

    <div id="chanCol">
      <div id="chanColHeader"><button class="notify-btn" id="notifyBtn" onclick="toggleNotifications()" title="Notifications">🔔</button><span id="headerUnread"></span><span id="chanColTitle">Bored Chat</span></div>
      <div id="chanColBanner"></div>
      <div id="chanColDesc"></div>

      <div class="sidebar-tabs">
        <button class="sidebar-tab-btn active" id="sidebarTabFriends" onclick="switchSidebarTab('friends')">Friends<span class="badge-dot" id="incomingReqBadge" style="display:none;"></span></button>
        <button class="sidebar-tab-btn" id="sidebarTabGroups" onclick="switchSidebarTab('groups')">Channels</button>
      </div>

      <div id="panelScroll">
        <div id="friendsPanel">
          <div class="general-nav-btn-wrap" style="padding:0 8px 6px;">
            <div class="list-item" id="generalNavBtn" onclick="openGeneralChat()" style="margin:0 0 6px;">
              <span class="hash">#</span><span class="item-name">general</span><span id="generalUnread"></span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="add-friend-row">
            <input type="text" id="addFriendInput" placeholder="Add friend by username…" maxlength="20" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')sendFriendRequestFromInput()">
            <button onclick="sendFriendRequestFromInput()">Add</button>
          </div>
          <div class="add-friend-msg" id="addFriendMsg"></div>

          <div id="incomingRequestsBlock" style="display:none;"><div class="sidebar-section-title">Requests</div><div id="incomingRequestsList"></div></div>
          <div id="outgoingRequestsBlock" style="display:none;"><div class="sidebar-section-title">Pending</div><div id="outgoingRequestsList"></div></div>

          <div class="sidebar-section-title"><span>Direct Messages</span></div>
          <div id="friendsList"></div>

          <div id="blockedBlock" style="display:none;"><div class="sidebar-section-title"><span>Blocked</span></div><div id="blockedList"></div></div>

          <div id="modBlock" style="display:none;">
            <div class="sidebar-section-title"><span>Ban / mute by username</span></div>
            <div class="add-friend-row">
              <input type="text" id="modUsernameInput" placeholder="Username…" maxlength="20" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')modActionByUsername('ban')">
              <button style="background:var(--danger);" onclick="modActionByUsername('ban')">Ban</button>
              <button style="background:var(--gold);color:#1e1f22;" onclick="modActionByUsername('mute')">Mute</button>
            </div>
            <div class="add-friend-row">
              <button style="background:var(--online);flex:1;padding:8px 0;" onclick="modActionByUsername('unban')">Unban username</button>
              <button style="background:var(--bg-input);flex:1;padding:8px 0;" onclick="modActionByUsername('unmute')">Unmute username</button>
            </div>
            <div class="add-friend-msg" id="modUsernameMsg"></div>
            <div class="sidebar-section-title"><span>Muted</span></div>
            <div id="mutedAdminList"></div>
            <div class="sidebar-section-title"><span>Banned</span></div>
            <div id="bannedAdminList"></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div id="groupsPanel" style="display:none;">
          <div id="serverActions" style="display:none;padding:4px 8px 0;">
            <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;">
              <button class="chan-action-btn" style="flex:1;" onclick="openServerInvite()">🔗 Invite</button>
              <button class="chan-action-btn" style="flex:1;" onclick="openServerSettings()">⚙️ Settings</button>
            </div>
            <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:6px;">
              <button class="chan-action-btn" id="muteServerBtn" style="flex:1;" onclick="toggleMuteCurrentServer()">🔔 Server alerts on</button>
            </div>
            <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:6px;">
              <button class="chan-action-btn warn" style="flex:1;" onclick="leaveCurrentServer()">Leave</button>
              <button class="chan-action-btn" id="deleteServerBtn" style="flex:1;display:none;color:var(--danger);" onclick="deleteCurrentServer()">Delete</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="add-friend-row" style="margin-top:4px;">
            <input type="text" id="joinCodeInput" placeholder="Join with an invite code…" maxlength="12" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')joinChannelByCode()">
            <button onclick="joinChannelByCode()">Join</button>
          </div>
          <div class="add-friend-msg" id="joinCodeMsg"></div>

          <div id="publicChannelsBlock">
            <div class="sidebar-section-title"><span>Public Channels</span></div>
            <div id="publicChannelsList"></div>
          </div>

          <div class="sidebar-section-title">
            <span id="channelsTitle">Your Channels</span>
            <button class="new-group-btn" onclick="openNewGroupModal()" title="Create channel">+</button>
          </div>
          <div id="groupsList"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="voice-status-bar" id="voiceStatusBar">
        🎙️ <span class="vname" id="voiceStatusName"></span>
        <button onclick="leaveVoiceChannel()">Leave</button>
      </div>

      <div id="userBar">
        <div class="user-block" onclick="openProfileModal()">
          <span id="currentUserAvatarSlot"></span>
          <div class="user-info"><b id="userBarName"></b><span id="userBarStatus">Online</span></div>
        </div>
        <span class="admin-badge" id="adminBadge" style="display:none;">👑 OWNER</span>
        <button class="bar-icon-btn" onclick="logout()" title="Log out">⏻</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div id="chatMain">
      <div class="chat-header">
        <div class="header-left">
          <button class="sidebar-toggle-btn" onclick="toggleSidebarMobile()">☰<span id="mobileUnread"></span></button>
          <div class="current-chat-label-wrap">
            <span class="current-chat-label" id="currentChatLabel"></span>
            <span class="current-chat-sub" id="currentChatSub"></span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="header-right">
          <button class="chan-action-btn" id="headerMuteBtn" style="display:none;" onclick="toggleMuteCurrentChat()" title="Mute or unmute this chat">🔔 Alerts on</button>
          <button class="chan-action-btn" id="headerAddPeopleBtn" style="display:none;" onclick="openAddMemberModal()">+ Add people</button>
          <button class="chan-action-btn" id="headerRenameBtn" style="display:none;" onclick="renameCurrentChannel()">✏️ Rename</button>
          <button class="chan-action-btn" id="headerInviteBtn" style="display:none;" onclick="openInviteModal()">🔗 Invite code</button>
          <button class="chan-action-btn warn" id="headerLeaveBtn" style="display:none;" onclick="leaveCurrentChannel()">Leave</button>
          <button class="call-header-btn" id="headerCallAudioBtn" style="display:none;" onclick="startCallWithCurrentFriend('audio')" title="Voice call">📞</button>
          <button class="call-header-btn video" id="headerCallVideoBtn" style="display:none;" onclick="startCallWithCurrentFriend('video')" title="Video call">🎥</button>
          <button class="members-toggle-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('onlineCol').classList.toggle('mobile-open')" title="Show online users and server members">👥</button>
          <button class="search-btn" id="searchToggleBtn" onclick="toggleSearch()" title="Search messages">🔍</button>
          <button class="tutorial-btn" onclick="openTutorial()" title="How this works">❓</button>
          <span class="conn-pill" id="connPill">connecting…</span>
          <button class="my-profile-btn" onclick="openProfileModal()" title="Profile">👤</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="searchBar">
        <input type="text" id="searchInput" placeholder="Search this channel…" oninput="handleSearchInput()">
        <span id="searchCount"></span>
        <button class="search-close-btn" onclick="closeSearch()" title="Close search">✕</button>
      </div>

      <div class="promo-strip">
        🎥 Enjoying Bored Chat? Check out
        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@ShadowDefender2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ShadowDefender2 on YouTube</a> and subscribe.
      </div>

      <div class="voice-panel" id="voicePanel">
        <button class="voice-join-btn" id="voiceJoinBtn" onclick="voiceJoinBtnClick()">🎙️ Join Voice</button>
        <div id="voiceChipsRow" style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;flex:1;"></div>
      </div>

      <div id="messages"></div>
      <div id="typingBar"></div>
      <div class="composer-note" id="composerNote" style="display:none;">You're muted, so you can't send messages right now.</div>

      <div id="composer">
        <button id="attachBtn" onclick="openAttachMediaModal()" title="Send an image">📎</button>
        <div id="msgInputWrap">
          <input type="text" id="msgInput" placeholder="Message…" maxlength="500" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')sendMessage()" oninput="handleTypingInput()">
          <button id="sendBtn" onclick="sendMessage()">Send</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div id="onlineCol">
      <div class="online-section" id="onlineSection">
        <div id="onlineColHeader">Online — <span id="onlineCount">0</span></div>
        <div id="onlineColScroll"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="online-section" id="serverMembersSection" style="display:none;">
        <div id="serverMembersHeader">Server members — <span id="serverMembersCount"></span></div>
        <div id="serverMembersScroll"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ADD SERVER MODAL -->
  <div class="modal-overlay" id="serverModal">
    <div class="modal-card">
      <h3>Add a Server</h3>
      <p class="sub">Create your own private server, or join one with an invite code.</p>
      <input type="text" id="newServerName" maxlength="24" placeholder="Server name" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')createServer()">
      <button class="primary-btn" style="margin-top:0;" onclick="createServer()">Create server</button>
      <p class="sub" style="margin:18px 0 8px;">Or join an existing server</p>
      <input type="text" id="joinServerCode" maxlength="12" placeholder="Invite code" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')joinServerByCode()">

        <div class="tut-step" data-step="2"><span class="tut-glyph">#️⃣</span><h4>Channels</h4><p>#general is open to everyone. In the Channels tab you can make invite-only channels and share the invite code. Channels inside a server are for that server's members only.</p></div>

To silence one chat press <b>🔔 Alerts on</b> in the chat's top bar; to silence a whole server press <b>🔔 Server alerts on</b> in the server sidebar. Muted chats show 🔕. Mutes are saved in this browser, and notifications only work while the page is open.</p></div>

Server owners can press ⚙️ Settings to set a name, description, emoji or image icon, a banner (paste a link or upload a file) and an accent color that recolors the app while you're in that server.</p></div>

In any chat box you can type <b>/ban name</b>, <b>/unban name</b>, <b>/mute name</b> or <b>/unmute name</b>. Each browser tab keeps its own login, so you can test with a second account in another tab.</p></div>

<script>
/* =========================================================
   FIREBASE CONFIG
========================================================= */
const firebaseConfig = {
  apiKey: "AIzaSyCqfKnFXqgOpw2PDZe99ceLidTPahj-gCM",
  authDomain: "chat12412412.firebaseapp.com",
  databaseURL: "https://chat12412412-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com/",
  projectId: "chat12412412",
  storageBucket: "chat12412412.firebasestorage.app",
  messagingSenderId: "690794971369",
  appId: "1:690794971369:web:05972a70431bb6519db078"
};
firebase.initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
const db = firebase.database();
const auth = firebase.auth();
// Keep the login per TAB, not per browser: logging into another account in a second tab used to sign
// the first tab out underneath you (which made owner actions fail with "permission denied").
const authReady = auth.setPersistence(firebase.auth.Auth.Persistence.SESSION).catch(() => {});
let myUid = null;

/* The owner account is "ShadowSmp". Its password is checked by the database rules (see database.rules.json), not by this page.
   This name only controls the OWNER badge. */
const ADMIN_USERNAME = 'ShadowSmp';
const GENERAL_CHAT_ID = 'general';
const ICE_SERVERS = [{ urls: ['stun:stun.l.google.com:19302', 'stun:stun1.l.google.com:19302'] }];
const AVATAR_COLORS = ['#5865f2','#eb459e','#faa61a','#23a55a','#f23f42','#3ba55d','#5865f2'];

let currentUser = null, myKey = null, isAdmin = false;
auth.onAuthStateChanged((u) => {
  if(currentUser && myUid && (!u || u.uid !== myUid)){
    alert('You were signed out because this account was signed in somewhere else. Please log in again.');
    location.reload();
  }
});
let authMode = 'login', sidebarTab = 'friends', needInitialChat = false;
let serversCache = {}, currentServerId = null, inviteModalServerId = null;

let friendsCache = {}, incomingRequestsCache = {}, outgoingRequestsCache = {}, blockedCache = {};
let chatsMetaCache = {}, nicknamesCache = {}, statusCache = {}, avatarsCache = {};
let voiceParticipantsAllCache = {}, mutedCache = {}, bannedCache = {}, pinnedCache = {};

let currentChatId = null, currentChatMeta = null, currentMessagesList = [], searchQuery = '';

let friendsRef=null, incomingReqRef=null, outgoingReqRef=null, blockedRef=null, nicknamesRef=null,
    statusRef=null, avatarsRef=null, myStatusRef=null, mutedRef=null, bannedRef=null, pinnedRef=null;
let messagesRef=null, messagesListener=null, typingRef=null, typingListener=null;
let typingSelfTimeout=null, iAmTyping=false, incomingCallRef=null;

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
function sanitizeUsernameKey(u){ return u.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[.#$\[\]\/\s]/g, '_'); }
function dmChatId(a, b){ const p=[a,b].sort(); return 'dm_' + p[0] + '__' + p[1]; }
function pairId(a, b){ const p=[a,b].sort(); return p[0] + '__' + p[1]; }
async function hashPassword(s){
  const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(s));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
}
function escapeHtml(str){ const d=document.createElement('div'); d.textContent=str; return d.innerHTML; }
function escapeRegExp(str){ return str.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'); }
function colorForKey(key){ let h=0; for(let i=0;i<key.length;i++) h=(h*31+key.charCodeAt(i))>>>0; return AVATAR_COLORS[h % AVATAR_COLORS.length]; }
function waitFor(cond, ms){
  return new Promise(res => { const t0 = Date.now(); (function tick(){ if(cond()) return res(true); if(Date.now()-t0 > ms) return res(false); setTimeout(tick, 80); })(); });
}

/* =========================================================
   LANGUAGE FILTER — slurs / strong profanity => automatic ban
   Edit BAD_WORDS to add or remove words. [word, startsAtWordBoundary, endsAtWordBoundary]
   Catches repeated letters (fuuuck), symbol swaps (f*ck-style leetspeak like @ $ 1 3 0),
   and spacing/punctuation tricks (f.u.c.k). Short words use word boundaries so
   innocent words like "snigger" or "Dickinson" aren't hit.
   NOTE: "dick" will also flag someone's name or message if they're called Dick.
========================================================= */
const AUTO_BAN = true;   // false = just block the message instead of banning
const BAD_WORDS = [
  ['fuck',false,false], ['fck',true,true], ['fuk',true,true],
  ['pussy',false,false], ['bitch',false,false],
  ['dick',true,true], ['nigga',true,true], ['nigger',true,true]
];
const BAD_GAP = '[^a-z]{0,2}';
const BAD_REGEXES = BAD_WORDS.map(([w, startB, endB]) => {
  const body = w.split('').map(c => c + '+').join(BAD_GAP);
  return new RegExp((startB ? '(?<![a-z])' : '') + body + (endB ? '(?:s|z|es|ed|y|head|heads|face)?(?![a-z])' : ''));
});
function normalizeForFilter(text){
  return String(text || '').normalize('NFKD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f\u200b-\u200f\u2060\ufeff]/g, '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[@4]/g,'a').replace(/3/g,'e').replace(/[1!|]/g,'i').replace(/0/g,'o').replace(/[$5]/g,'s').replace(/7/g,'t');
}
function containsBannedWord(text){
  const n = normalizeForFilter(text);
  return BAD_REGEXES.some(r => r.test(n));
}
function nameIsClean(text){ return isAdmin || !containsBannedWord(text); }

async function autoBanForLanguage(){
  if(!AUTO_BAN){ alert("That language isn't allowed here."); return; }
  try{
    await db.ref('bannedUsers/' + myKey).set(currentUser);
    const sg = await getSignals();
    await db.ref('bannedDevices/' + sg.deviceId).set(myKey);
    await db.ref('bannedDevices/s_' + sg.sig).set(myKey);
    await db.ref('banInfo/' + myKey).set({ d: sg.deviceId, s: sg.sig });
  }catch(err){ console.error('auto-ban failed', err); }
  if(currentUser){ alert('You have been banned for using prohibited language.'); logout(); }
}

/* ---------- images ----------
   No image scanning or verification anywhere. These tiny helpers exist so the rest of the code keeps working. */
const VIDEO_RE = /\.(mp4|webm|ogv|mov|m4v)(\?|#|$)/i;
function isPrivateMeta(meta){ return !!meta && meta.type !== 'public'; }
function imageVerdict(url){ return 'safe'; }
async function isImageSafeNow(url){ return 'safe'; }

/* ---------- one account per device ---------- */
function getDeviceId(){
  let id = null;
  try{ id = localStorage.getItem('bc_device_id'); }catch(e){}
  if(!id){ const m = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|; )bc_device_id=([^;]+)/); if(m) id = m[1]; }
  if(!id) id = (crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : 'd' + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)).replace(/-/g,'');
  try{ localStorage.setItem('bc_device_id', id); }catch(e){}
  document.cookie = 'bc_device_id=' + id + '; max-age=315360000; path=/; SameSite=Lax';
  return id;
}
/* Ban evasion protection. Anyone can make accounts, but each login records two "signals":
     1. a device ID kept in the browser (cookie + localStorage), and
     2. a signature = hash(browser/hardware fingerprint + public IP address).
   Banning an account bans both. Register/login is refused if EITHER matches a banned one, so clearing
   cookies or making a new account doesn't help. Only hashes are stored, never the IP itself. */
let cachedSignals = null;
async function fetchPublicIp(){
  try{
    const ctl = new AbortController();
    const t = setTimeout(() => ctl.abort(), 3500);
    const r = await fetch('https://api.ipify.org?format=json', { signal: ctl.signal });
    clearTimeout(t);
    const j = await r.json();
    return j.ip || 'noip';
  }catch(e){ return 'noip'; }
}
async function computeFingerprint(){
  const parts = [navigator.userAgent, navigator.language, navigator.platform,
    screen.width + 'x' + screen.height + 'x' + screen.colorDepth,
    (Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone || ''), navigator.hardwareConcurrency || '', navigator.deviceMemory || ''];
  try{
    const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 220; c.height = 40;
    const x = c.getContext('2d'); x.textBaseline = 'top'; x.font = '16px Arial';
    x.fillStyle = '#f60'; x.fillRect(10, 5, 100, 25); x.fillStyle = '#069'; x.fillText('BoredChat fp 123', 12, 8);
    parts.push(c.toDataURL());
  }catch(e){}
  try{
    const g = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('webgl');
    const ext = g && g.getExtension('WEBGL_debug_renderer_info');
    if(ext) parts.push(g.getParameter(ext.UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL));
  }catch(e){}
  return (await hashPassword(parts.join('||'))).slice(0, 40);
}
async function getSignals(){
  if(cachedSignals) return cachedSignals;
  const [fp, ip] = await Promise.all([computeFingerprint(), fetchPublicIp()]);
  cachedSignals = { deviceId: getDeviceId(), ip, sig: (await hashPassword('sig|' + fp + '|' + ip)).slice(0, 40) };
  return cachedSignals;
}
async function checkAndBindDevice(userKey){
  if(userKey === ADMIN_USERNAME.toLowerCase()) return null;   // the owner can never be locked out
  const sg = await getSignals();
  const [byDevice, bySig] = await Promise.all([
    db.ref('bannedDevices/' + sg.deviceId).get(),
    sg.ip !== 'noip' ? db.ref('bannedDevices/s_' + sg.sig).get() : Promise.resolve({ exists: () => false })
  ]);
  if(byDevice.exists() || bySig.exists()) return "You're banned — this device or connection can't be used on Bored Chat.";
  return null;
}
async function bindDevice(userKey){
  const sg = await getSignals();
  await db.ref('users/' + userKey).update({ deviceId: sg.deviceId, sig: sg.sig });
}
// Ban every signal we know for this account (called by owner bans and the auto-moderator).
async function banSignalsOfKey(key){
  const [d, sgn] = await Promise.all([db.ref('users/' + key + '/deviceId').get(), db.ref('users/' + key + '/sig').get()]);
  const deviceId = d.exists() ? d.val() : null, sig = sgn.exists() ? sgn.val() : null;
  const up = {};
  if(deviceId) up['bannedDevices/' + deviceId] = key;
  if(sig) up['bannedDevices/s_' + sig] = key;
  if(deviceId || sig) up['banInfo/' + key] = { d: deviceId || '', s: sig || '' };
  if(Object.keys(up).length) await db.ref().update(up);
}

function avatarHtml(username, size){
  const key = sanitizeUsernameKey(username || '?');
  const rawUrl = avatarsCache[key];
  const url = (rawUrl && (isOwnerKey(key) || imageVerdict(rawUrl) === 'safe')) ? rawUrl : null;
  const cls = 'avatar avatar-' + (size || 'sm');
  if(url){
    return `<span class="${cls}"><img src="${escapeHtml(url)}" onerror="this.parentElement.outerHTML=window.__fallbackAvatar('${escapeHtml(username||'?')}','${size||'sm'}')" alt=""></span>`;
  }
  return window.__fallbackAvatar(username, size);
}
window.__fallbackAvatar = function(username, size){
  const key = sanitizeUsernameKey(username || '?');
  const letter = (username || '?').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase() || '?';
  return `<span class="avatar avatar-${size || 'sm'}" style="background:${colorForKey(key)}">${escapeHtml(letter)}</span>`;
};

function displayNameFor(username){
  const key = sanitizeUsernameKey(username || '');
  return nicknamesCache[key] || username;
}
function isBlockedUsername(u){ return !!blockedCache[sanitizeUsernameKey(u || '')]; }
let ownerKey = null;   // lowercase owner username, set at login
function isOwnerKey(key){ return key === (ownerKey || ADMIN_USERNAME.toLowerCase()); }
function ownerBadgeHtml(key){ return isOwnerKey(key) ? ' <span class="owner-tag">👑 OWNER</span>' : ''; }
function mutedTagHtml(key){ return mutedCache[key] ? ' <span class="muted-tag">🔇 muted</span>' : ''; }
function amMuted(){ return !isAdmin && !!mutedCache[myKey]; }

function setConnPill(state){
  const pill = document.getElementById('connPill');
  if(state === 'online'){ pill.textContent='● Connected'; pill.className='conn-pill online'; }
  else if(state === 'offline'){ pill.textContent='● Offline'; pill.className='conn-pill offline'; }
  else { pill.textContent='connecting…'; pill.className='conn-pill'; }
}
db.ref('.info/connected').on('value', (snap) => {
  if(document.getElementById('chatScreen').style.display === 'flex') setConnPill(snap.val() === true ? 'online' : 'offline');
});

/* ---------- tutorial ---------- */
let tutStepIndex = 0;
function tutSteps(){ return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.tut-step')).filter(el => !el.dataset.owner || isAdmin); }
function openTutorial(){ tutStepIndex = 0; renderTutorialStep(); document.getElementById('tutorialModal').classList.add('open'); }
function closeTutorial(){ document.getElementById('tutorialModal').classList.remove('open'); }
function renderTutorialStep(){
  const steps = tutSteps();
  if(tutStepIndex > steps.length - 1) tutStepIndex = steps.length - 1;
  document.querySelectorAll('.tut-step').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
  if(steps[tutStepIndex]) steps[tutStepIndex].classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('tutDots').innerHTML = steps.map((_, i) =>
    `<span class="tut-dot ${i === tutStepIndex ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="tutorialGoTo(${i})"></span>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('tutBackBtn').style.visibility = tutStepIndex === 0 ? 'hidden' : 'visible';
  document.getElementById('tutNextBtn').textContent = tutStepIndex === steps.length - 1 ? 'Done' : 'Next';
}
function tutorialNext(){ if(tutStepIndex >= tutSteps().length - 1){ closeTutorial(); return; } tutStepIndex++; renderTutorialStep(); }
function tutorialBack(){ if(tutStepIndex <= 0) return; tutStepIndex--; renderTutorialStep(); }
function tutorialGoTo(i){ tutStepIndex = i; renderTutorialStep(); }

/* =========================================================
   AUTH — Firebase ANONYMOUS sign-in + a password proof checked by the database rules.
========================================================= */
function switchTab(mode){
  authMode = mode;
  document.getElementById('tabLogin').classList.toggle('active', mode==='login');
  document.getElementById('tabRegister').classList.toggle('active', mode==='register');
  document.getElementById('submitBtn').textContent = mode==='login' ? 'Continue' : 'Create Account';
  document.getElementById('authMsg').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('passwordInput').autocomplete = mode==='login' ? 'current-password' : 'new-password';
}

async function authSecret(userKey, password){ return await hashPassword('bc-pw|' + userKey + '|' + password); }
let signOutTimer = null;

// The owner is the ShadowSmp account that logged in with the owner password (verified by the database rules).
async function finishLogin(displayName, userKey){
  myUid = auth.currentUser ? auth.currentUser.uid : null;
  isAdmin = false;
  ownerKey = ADMIN_USERNAME.toLowerCase();
  if(userKey === ownerKey){
    // Only the account that logged in with the owner password is allowed to write here (checked by the database rules).
    try{
      await db.ref('system/adminCheck').set(firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP);
      isAdmin = true;
      displayName = ADMIN_USERNAME;
      await db.ref('users/' + userKey).update({ username: ADMIN_USERNAME, joined: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP });
    }catch(e){ console.error('owner check failed', e); }
  }
  loginSuccess(displayName, userKey);
}

/* Anonymous Firebase sign-in gives each browser a uid. To prove "I am <username>" the page
   writes a password proof (a hash) to proofs/<uid>; the database rules compare it with the
   stored secret WITHOUT ever letting anyone read it, and only then link uid -> username. */
async function handleAuthSubmit(e){
  if(e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
  const usernameRaw = document.getElementById('usernameInput').value.trim();
  const password = document.getElementById('passwordInput').value;
  const msgEl = document.getElementById('authMsg');
  const submitBtn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
  msgEl.style.color = 'var(--danger)';
  msgEl.textContent = '';

  if(!usernameRaw || !password){ msgEl.textContent = 'Please fill in both fields.'; return; }
  if(password.length < 4){ msgEl.textContent = 'Password must be at least 4 characters.'; return; }
  const userKey = sanitizeUsernameKey(usernameRaw);
  if(!userKey){ msgEl.textContent = 'Please choose a different username.'; return; }
  if(authMode === 'register' && containsBannedWord(usernameRaw)){ msgEl.textContent = "That username isn't allowed."; return; }

  submitBtn.disabled = true;
  const originalLabel = submitBtn.textContent;
  submitBtn.textContent = 'Please wait…';

  try{
    const secret = await authSecret(userKey, password);
    const legacy = await hashPassword(password);          // old accounts used this
    clearTimeout(signOutTimer);
    await authReady;
    if(auth.currentUser) await auth.signOut();
    const cred = await auth.signInAnonymously();
    const uid = cred.user.uid;
    const fail = async (m) => { try{ await auth.signOut(); }catch(_){} msgEl.textContent = m; };
    const claim = async (proof) => {
      await db.ref('proofs/' + uid).set(proof);
      await db.ref('uidToKey/' + uid).set(userKey);       // rejected by the rules if the proof is wrong
    };

    const devErr = await checkAndBindDevice(userKey);
    if(devErr){ await fail(devErr); return; }

    if(authMode === 'register'){
      try{ await db.ref('secrets/' + userKey).set(secret); }
      catch(err){ await fail('That name is already taken. Try logging in.'); return; }
      await claim(secret);
      const sgReg = await getSignals();
      await db.ref('users/' + userKey).set({ username: usernameRaw, deviceId: sgReg.deviceId, sig: sgReg.sig, joined: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP });
      await finishLogin(usernameRaw, userKey);
    } else {
      let ok = false, usedLegacy = false;
      try{ await claim(secret); ok = true; }catch(err){}
      if(!ok){ try{ await claim(legacy); ok = true; usedLegacy = true; }catch(err){} }
      if(!ok){ await fail('Incorrect username or password.'); return; }
      if(usedLegacy){          // upgrade an old account to the new secret and drop its old hash
        try{ await db.ref('secrets/' + userKey).set(secret); await db.ref('users/' + userKey + '/passwordHash').remove(); }
        catch(err){ console.error('upgrade failed', err); }
      }
      const banSnap = await db.ref('bannedUsers/' + userKey).get();
      if(banSnap.exists()){ await fail('You have been banned from Bored Chat.'); return; }
      let display = usernameRaw;
      try{ const n = await db.ref('users/' + userKey + '/username').get(); if(n.exists()) display = n.val(); }catch(err){}
      await bindDevice(userKey);
      await finishLogin(display, userKey);
    }
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    const code = err && err.code ? ' (' + err.code + ')' : '';
    msgEl.textContent = 'Could not sign in' + code + ': ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'unknown error');
  }finally{
    submitBtn.disabled = false;
    submitBtn.textContent = originalLabel;
  }
}

function loginSuccess(username, userKey){
  currentUser = username;
  myKey = userKey;
  document.getElementById('authScreen').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('chatScreen').style.display = 'flex';
  document.getElementById('adminBadge').style.display = isAdmin ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
  setConnPill('connecting');
  renderMyUserBar();
  updateNotifyButton();

  ensureGeneralChatExists().then(() => {
    needInitialChat = true;
    startFriendsListener();
    startIncomingRequestsListener();
    startOutgoingRequestsListener();
    startBlockedListener();
    startMembershipListeners();
    startNicknamesListener();
    startStatusListener();
    startAvatarsListener();
    startIncomingCallListener();
    startMutedListener();
    startBannedListener();
    startPinnedListener();
    startPresence();
    switchSidebarTab('friends');
    if(isAdmin) ownerSelfTest();
  });
}

function logout(){
  endCall();
  leaveVoiceChannel();
  stopMessageListener();
  stopTypingListener();
  clearInterval(heartbeatTimer); clearInterval(presenceRenderTimer); window.onpagehide = null;
  if(connPresenceRef){ connPresenceRef.off('value'); connPresenceRef = null; }
  if(myStatusRef) myStatusRef.set({ state:'offline', username: currentUser, last_changed: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP });
  [friendsRef,incomingReqRef,outgoingReqRef,blockedRef,nicknamesRef,statusRef,avatarsRef,incomingCallRef,mutedRef,bannedRef]
    .forEach(r => { if(r) r.off('value'); });
  stopAllWatchers();
  friendsRef=incomingReqRef=outgoingReqRef=blockedRef=nicknamesRef=statusRef=avatarsRef=incomingCallRef=myStatusRef=mutedRef=bannedRef=null;

  currentUser=null; myKey=null; myUid=null; isAdmin=false; needInitialChat=false;
  friendsCache={}; incomingRequestsCache={}; outgoingRequestsCache={}; blockedCache={};
  chatsMetaCache={}; nicknamesCache={}; statusCache={}; avatarsCache={}; voiceParticipantsAllCache={};
  mutedCache={}; bannedCache={}; serversCache={}; currentServerId=null; pinnedCache={};
  currentChatId=null; currentChatMeta=null; currentMessagesList=[];
  applyServerTheme(null);

  document.getElementById('chatScreen').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('authScreen').style.display = 'flex';
  document.getElementById('usernameInput').value = '';
  document.getElementById('passwordInput').value = '';
  document.getElementById('authMsg').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('chanCol').classList.remove('mobile-open');
  signOutTimer = setTimeout(() => { auth.signOut(); }, 800);
}

/* Runs once when the owner logs in: tells you straight away if the Firebase rules you published are out of date. */
async function ownerSelfTest(){
  const msgEl = document.getElementById('modUsernameMsg');
  let problem = null;
  try{ await db.ref('rulesCheck/v5').get(); }
  catch(e){ problem = 'The rules published in Firebase are OUT OF DATE.'; }
  if(!problem){
    const bad = [];
    for(const [path, name] of [['bannedUsers/__selftest','ban'], ['mutedUsers/__selftest','mute'], ['bannedDevices/__selftest','device ban'], ['banInfo/__selftest','ban records']]){
      try{ await db.ref(path).set('x'); await db.ref(path).remove(); }catch(e){ bad.push(name); }
    }
    if(bad.length) problem = 'Firebase rejected these owner actions: ' + bad.join(', ') + '.';
  }
  if(problem){
    const text = problem + ' Open Firebase → Realtime Database → Rules, paste the newest database.rules.json, press Publish, then reload this page.';
    if(msgEl){ msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg'; msgEl.textContent = '⚠️ ' + text; }
    alert('⚠️ ' + text);
  } else if(msgEl){ msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg ok'; msgEl.textContent = '✅ Owner permissions are working.'; }
}

/* ---------- presence ---------- */
function startPresence(){
  const TS = firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP;
  myStatusRef = db.ref('status/' + myKey);
  if(connPresenceRef) connPresenceRef.off('value');
  connPresenceRef = db.ref('.info/connected');
  connPresenceRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    if(snap.val() === false || !myKey) return;
    myStatusRef.onDisconnect().set({ state:'offline', username: currentUser, last_changed: TS })
      .then(() => myStatusRef.set({ state:'online', username: currentUser, last_changed: TS }));
  });
  clearInterval(heartbeatTimer); clearInterval(presenceRenderTimer);
  heartbeatTimer = setInterval(() => {
    if(myStatusRef) myStatusRef.update({ state:'online', username: currentUser, last_changed: TS }).catch(()=>{});
  }, 30000);
  presenceRenderTimer = setInterval(() => { renderOnlineList(); renderFriendsList(); renderServerRail(); updateCurrentChatLabel(); }, 30000);
  window.onpagehide = () => { if(myStatusRef) myStatusRef.set({ state:'offline', username: currentUser, last_changed: TS }); };
}

function startStatusListener(){
  statusRef = db.ref('status');
  statusRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    statusCache = snap.val() || {};
    renderFriendsList(); updateCurrentChatLabel(); renderOnlineList(); renderServerRail();
  });
}
let serverOffset = 0, heartbeatTimer = null, presenceRenderTimer = null, connPresenceRef = null;
db.ref('.info/serverTimeOffset').on('value', s => { serverOffset = s.val() || 0; });
const ONLINE_FRESH_MS = 90000;   // no heartbeat for 90s => shown offline
function isOnline(k){
  const st = statusCache[k];
  return !!(st && st.state === 'online' && st.last_changed && (Date.now() + serverOffset - st.last_changed) < ONLINE_FRESH_MS);
}

function renderServerMembers(){
  const sec = document.getElementById('serverMembersSection');
  const scroll = document.getElementById('serverMembersScroll');
  const countEl = document.getElementById('serverMembersCount');
  if(!sec || !scroll || !countEl) return;
  const sv = currentServerId ? serversCache[currentServerId] : null;
  if(!sv){ sec.style.display = 'none'; return; }
  sec.style.display = 'flex';
  const keys = Object.keys(sv.members || {});
  const nameFor = (k) => (statusCache[k] && statusCache[k].username) || friendsCache[k] || (k === myKey ? currentUser : k);
  countEl.textContent = keys.filter(k => isOnline(k)).length + '/' + keys.length + ' online';
  keys.sort((a, b) => (isOnline(b) - isOnline(a)) || nameFor(a).localeCompare(nameFor(b)));
  scroll.innerHTML = keys.map(k => {
    const on = isOnline(k);
    const username = nameFor(k);
    const isMe = k === myKey, clickable = !isMe && !!friendsCache[k];
    const crown = (k === sv.createdBy) ? ' 👑' : '';
    return `<div class="online-item ${on ? '' : 'offline'}" ${clickable ? `onclick="openFriendDm('${k}')"` : ''} title="${on ? 'Online' : 'Offline'}${clickable ? ' — click to message' : ''}">
      ${avatarHtml(username,'xs')}
      <span class="mdot ${on ? 'on' : 'off'}"></span>
      <span class="item-name">${escapeHtml(isMe ? username : displayNameFor(username))}${crown}${ownerBadgeHtml(k)}</span>
      ${isMe ? '<span class="you-tag">you</span>' : ''}
    </div>`;
  }).join('') || '<div class="online-empty-note">No members yet.</div>';
}
function renderOnlineList(){
  const scroll = document.getElementById('onlineColScroll');
  const countEl = document.getElementById('onlineCount');
  if(!scroll || !countEl) return;
  renderServerMembers();
  const keys = Object.keys(statusCache).filter(k => isOnline(k));
  countEl.textContent = keys.length;
  if(!keys.length){ scroll.innerHTML = '<div class="online-empty-note">Nobody else is around right now.</div>'; return; }
  const nameFor = (k) => (statusCache[k] && statusCache[k].username) || friendsCache[k] || k;
  keys.sort((a,b) => nameFor(a).localeCompare(nameFor(b)));
  scroll.innerHTML = keys.map(k => {
    const username = nameFor(k);
    const shown = (k === myKey ? username : displayNameFor(username)) + ownerBadgeHtml(k) + mutedTagHtml(k);
    const isMe = k === myKey, isFriend = !!friendsCache[k], clickable = isMe || isFriend;
    const rawEsc = escapeHtml(username).replace(/'/g,"\\'");
    const modBtns = (isAdmin && !isMe) ? `
      <button class="mini-btn mute" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleMuteUserByKey('${k}','${rawEsc}')" title="${mutedCache[k] ? 'Unmute' : 'Mute'}">${mutedCache[k] ? '🔊' : '🔇'}</button>
      <button class="mini-btn ban" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); banUserByKey('${k}','${rawEsc}')" title="Ban">⛔</button>` : '';
    return `<div class="online-item" ${clickable && !isMe ? `onclick="openFriendDm('${k}')"` : ''} title="${clickable ? (isMe ? 'You' : 'Open DM') : 'Add them as a friend to message'}">
      ${avatarHtml(username,'xs')}
      <span class="presence-dot online" style="margin-left:-20px;margin-top:12px;"></span>
      <span class="item-name">${escapeHtml(shown)}</span>
      ${isMe ? '<span class="you-tag">you</span>' : modBtns}
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}
