async function muteUserByKey(key, username){
  if(!isAdmin || !key || key === myKey) return;
  try{ await db.ref('mutedUsers/' + key).set(username); return true; }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to mute user', err); alert('Mute failed: ' + (err.message || 'permission denied') + '\n\nIf this says permission denied, publish the newest database.rules.json in Firebase.'); return false; }
}
async function unmuteUserByKey(key){
  if(!isAdmin) return;
  try{ await db.ref('mutedUsers/' + key).remove(); return true; }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to unmute user', err); alert('Unmute failed: ' + (err.message || 'permission denied')); return false; }
}
async function toggleMuteUserByKey(key, username){
  if(mutedCache[key]) await unmuteUserByKey(key); else await muteUserByKey(key, username);
}
async function purgeMessagesOfUser(key){
  const ids = Object.keys(chatsMetaCache).filter(id => { const m = chatsMetaCache[id]; return m && m.type !== 'dm' && canAccessChat(m); });
  const updates = {};
  await Promise.all(ids.map(async id => {
    try{
      const snap = await db.ref('chatsMsgs/' + id).get();
      const msgs = snap.val() || {};
      Object.keys(msgs).forEach(mid => { if(msgs[mid] && sanitizeUsernameKey(msgs[mid].user || '') === key) updates['chatsMsgs/' + id + '/' + mid] = null; });
    }catch(e){ console.error(e); }
  }));
  const n = Object.keys(updates).length;
  if(n) await db.ref().update(updates);
  return n;
}
async function banUserByKey(key, username){
  if(!isAdmin || !key || key === myKey) return;
  if(!confirm('Ban ' + username + '? They will be logged out, blocked from making new accounts on their device and connection, and ALL their messages in channels you can access will be deleted permanently.')) return;
  try{
    await db.ref('bannedUsers/' + key).set(username);
    await banSignalsOfKey(key);
    const n = await purgeMessagesOfUser(key);
    alert('Banned ' + username + ' and deleted ' + n + ' message(s).');
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to ban user', err); alert('Ban failed: ' + err.message); }
}
async function whoAmIText(){
  try{
    const u = auth.currentUser;
    if(!u) return 'Firebase says you are signed out.';
    const k = await db.ref('uidToKey/' + u.uid).get();
    return 'Firebase thinks you are: ' + (k.exists() ? k.val() : 'nobody (no account linked)') + '.';
  }catch(e){ return ''; }
}
async function unbanUserByKey(key){
  if(!isAdmin) return false;
  try{
    await db.ref('bannedUsers/' + key).remove();
    try{
      const ids = new Set();
      const info = await db.ref('banInfo/' + key).get();
      if(info.exists()){ const v = info.val(); if(v.d) ids.add(v.d); if(v.s) ids.add('s_' + v.s); }
      const [d, sg] = await Promise.all([db.ref('users/' + key + '/deviceId').get(), db.ref('users/' + key + '/sig').get()]);
      if(d.exists()) ids.add(d.val());
      if(sg.exists()) ids.add('s_' + sg.val());
      for(const id of ids) await db.ref('bannedDevices/' + id).remove();
      await db.ref('banInfo/' + key).remove();
    }catch(e){ console.error('device unban', e); }
    return true;
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to unban user', err); alert('Unban failed: ' + (err.message || 'unknown error') + '\n\n' + await whoAmIText() + '\nIt should say shadowsmp. If not, log out and back in as Shadowsmp in THIS tab. If it does, publish the newest database.rules.json.'); return false; }
}
// Ban or mute anybody by typing their username (online or not).
async function modActionByUsername(action){
  if(!isAdmin) return;
  const input = document.getElementById('modUsernameInput');
  const msgEl = document.getElementById('modUsernameMsg');
  msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg';
  const raw = input.value.trim();
  if(!raw){ msgEl.textContent = 'Type a username first.'; return; }
  const key = sanitizeUsernameKey(raw);
  if(key === myKey){ msgEl.textContent = "You can't do that to yourself."; return; }
  try{
    const snap = await db.ref('users/' + key + '/username').get();
    if(!snap.exists() && action !== 'unban' && action !== 'unmute'){ msgEl.textContent = 'No account exists with that name.'; return; }
    const username = (snap.exists() && snap.val()) || raw;
    if(action === 'unban'){
      const ok = await unbanUserByKey(key);
      if(ok){ msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg ok'; msgEl.textContent = username + ' was unbanned.'; input.value = ''; }
    } else if(action === 'unmute'){
      if(await unmuteUserByKey(key)){ msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg ok'; msgEl.textContent = username + ' was unmuted.'; input.value = ''; }
    } else if(action === 'ban'){
      const before = !!bannedCache[key];
      await banUserByKey(key, username);
      if(bannedCache[key] && !before){ msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg ok'; msgEl.textContent = username + ' was banned.'; input.value = ''; }
    } else {
      if(await muteUserByKey(key, username)){ msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg ok'; msgEl.textContent = username + ' was muted.'; input.value = ''; }
    }
  }catch(err){ console.error(err); msgEl.textContent = 'Failed: ' + (err.message || 'unknown error'); }
}
function renderModBlock(){
  const block = document.getElementById('modBlock');
  if(!block) return;
  if(!isAdmin){ block.style.display = 'none'; return; }
  block.style.display = 'block';
  const mutedKeys = Object.keys(mutedCache);
  document.getElementById('mutedAdminList').innerHTML = mutedKeys.length ? mutedKeys.map(k => `
    <div class="request-row">${avatarHtml(mutedCache[k],'xs')}<span class="req-name">${escapeHtml(mutedCache[k])}</span>
    <button class="req-unblock" onclick="unmuteUserByKey('${k}')">Unmute</button></div>`).join('') : '<div class="empty-list-note">Nobody is muted.</div>';
  const bannedKeys = Object.keys(bannedCache);
  document.getElementById('bannedAdminList').innerHTML = bannedKeys.length ? bannedKeys.map(k => `
    <div class="request-row">${avatarHtml(bannedCache[k],'xs')}<span class="req-name">${escapeHtml(bannedCache[k])}</span>
    <button class="req-unblock" onclick="unbanUserByKey('${k}')">Unban</button></div>`).join('') : '<div class="empty-list-note">Nobody is banned.</div>';
}

function updateRequestBadge(){
  const badge = document.getElementById('incomingReqBadge');
  const n = Object.keys(incomingRequestsCache).filter(k => !blockedCache[k]).length;
  if(n > 0){ badge.style.display='inline-block'; badge.textContent = n; } else badge.style.display='none';
}

async function sendFriendRequestFromInput(){
  const input = document.getElementById('addFriendInput');
  const msgEl = document.getElementById('addFriendMsg');
  const targetRaw = input.value.trim();
  msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg'; msgEl.textContent = '';
  if(!targetRaw){ msgEl.textContent = 'Type a username first.'; return; }
  const targetKey = sanitizeUsernameKey(targetRaw);
  if(targetKey === myKey){ msgEl.textContent = "You can't add yourself."; return; }
  if(blockedCache[targetKey]){ msgEl.textContent = 'Unblock them first.'; return; }
  if(friendsCache[targetKey]){ msgEl.textContent = 'Already friends with them.'; return; }
  if(outgoingRequestsCache[targetKey]){ msgEl.textContent = 'Request already sent.'; return; }
  try{
    if(incomingRequestsCache[targetKey]){
      await acceptFriendRequest(targetKey, incomingRequestsCache[targetKey]);
      msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg ok'; msgEl.textContent = 'You were already friends-in-waiting — accepted!'; input.value = '';
      return;
    }
    const targetSnap = await db.ref('users/' + targetKey + '/username').get();
    if(!targetSnap.exists()){ msgEl.textContent = 'No account exists with that name.'; return; }
    const targetUsername = targetSnap.val() || targetRaw;
    await db.ref('friendRequests/' + targetKey + '/' + myKey).set(currentUser);
    await db.ref('sentRequests/' + myKey + '/' + targetKey).set(targetUsername);
    msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg ok'; msgEl.textContent = 'Friend request sent to ' + targetUsername + '.'; input.value = '';
  }catch(err){ console.error(err); msgEl.textContent = 'Could not send request: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'unknown error'); }
}
async function acceptFriendRequest(fromKey, fromUsername){
  await db.ref('friends/' + myKey + '/' + fromKey).set(fromUsername);
  await db.ref('friends/' + fromKey + '/' + myKey).set(currentUser);
  await db.ref('friendRequests/' + myKey + '/' + fromKey).remove();
  await db.ref('sentRequests/' + fromKey + '/' + myKey).remove();
}
async function declineIncomingRequest(fromKey){
  try{ await db.ref('friendRequests/' + myKey + '/' + fromKey).remove(); await db.ref('sentRequests/' + fromKey + '/' + myKey).remove(); }
  catch(err){ console.error('Failed to decline request', err); }
}
async function cancelOutgoingRequest(toKey){
  try{ await db.ref('sentRequests/' + myKey + '/' + toKey).remove(); await db.ref('friendRequests/' + toKey + '/' + myKey).remove(); }
  catch(err){ console.error('Failed to cancel request', err); }
}
async function acceptFriendRequestUI(fromKey){
  try{ await acceptFriendRequest(fromKey, incomingRequestsCache[fromKey]); }catch(err){ console.error(err); }
}
async function unfriend(friendKey){
  const name = friendsCache[friendKey] || friendKey;
  if(!confirm('Remove ' + name + ' as a friend? This will not delete your past messages.')) return;
  try{
    await db.ref('friends/' + myKey + '/' + friendKey).remove();
    await db.ref('friends/' + friendKey + '/' + myKey).remove();
    await db.ref('nicknames/' + myKey + '/' + friendKey).remove();
    await db.ref('pinnedFriends/' + myKey + '/' + friendKey).remove();
    if(currentChatMeta && currentChatMeta.type === 'dm' && currentChatId === dmChatId(myKey, friendKey)) clearChatView();
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to unfriend', err); }
}
async function blockUserByKey(targetKey, targetUsername){
  if(!targetKey || targetKey === myKey) return;
  if(!confirm('Block ' + targetUsername + '? You will stop seeing their messages everywhere, and they can no longer call or add you.')) return;
  try{
    await db.ref('blocked/' + myKey + '/' + targetKey).set(targetUsername);
    await db.ref('friends/' + myKey + '/' + targetKey).remove();
    await db.ref('friends/' + targetKey + '/' + myKey).remove();
    await db.ref('pinnedFriends/' + myKey + '/' + targetKey).remove();
    await db.ref('friendRequests/' + myKey + '/' + targetKey).remove();
    await db.ref('friendRequests/' + targetKey + '/' + myKey).remove();
    await db.ref('sentRequests/' + myKey + '/' + targetKey).remove();
    await db.ref('sentRequests/' + targetKey + '/' + myKey).remove();
    if(currentChatMeta && currentChatMeta.type === 'dm' && currentChatId === dmChatId(myKey, targetKey)) clearChatView();
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to block user', err); }
}
async function unblockUser(targetKey){
  try{ await db.ref('blocked/' + myKey + '/' + targetKey).remove(); }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to unblock user', err); }
}
async function setNicknameFor(friendKey, friendUsername){
  const val = prompt('Nickname for ' + friendUsername + ' (leave blank to clear):', nicknamesCache[friendKey] || '');
  if(val === null) return;
  const trimmed = val.trim();
  try{
    if(trimmed) await db.ref('nicknames/' + myKey + '/' + friendKey).set(trimmed);
    else await db.ref('nicknames/' + myKey + '/' + friendKey).remove();
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to save nickname', err); }
}

function renderFriendsList(){

  if(!keys.length){ list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-list-note">No friends yet. Add someone by username above.</div>'; return; }

      <button class="mini-btn ban" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); banUserByKey('${k}','${rawEsc}')" title="Ban">⛔</button>` : '';
    return `<div class="list-item ${active ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="openFriendDm('${k}')">
      ${avatarHtml(friendsCache[k],'xs')}

      <span class="presence-dot ${isOnline(k) ? 'online' : ''}" style="margin-left:-20px;margin-top:12px;"></span>

/* =========================================================
   DATA LAYER FOR PRIVATE CHATS / SERVERS
   The app no longer downloads every chat and server. It reads:
     memberships/<me>/chats|servers   (what I belong to)
     publicChannels                   (list of public channel ids)
     serverChannels/<server>          (channel ids inside my servers)
   and then listens only to those individual records, which the
   database rules allow only for members.
========================================================= */
let myChatIds = {}, myServerIds = {}, publicChatIds = {}, serverChanIds = {};
let myChatIdsRef=null, myServerIdsRef=null, publicChatIdsRef=null;
let chatMetaWatch = {}, chatMetaLoaded = {}, serverWatch = {}, serverChanWatch = {}, voiceWatch = {};

function startMembershipListeners(){
  myChatIdsRef = db.ref('memberships/' + myKey + '/chats');
  myChatIdsRef.on('value', s => { myChatIds = s.val() || {}; reconcileChatMetaWatchers(); });
  myServerIdsRef = db.ref('memberships/' + myKey + '/servers');
  myServerIdsRef.on('value', s => { myServerIds = s.val() || {}; reconcileServerWatchers(); });
  publicChatIdsRef = db.ref('publicChannels');
  publicChatIdsRef.on('value', s => { publicChatIds = s.val() || {}; reconcileChatMetaWatchers(); });
  setTimeout(() => { if(needInitialChat){ needInitialChat = false; openDefaultChat(); } }, 3000);
}

function reconcileChatMetaWatchers(){
  const wanted = Object.assign({}, myChatIds, publicChatIds);
  Object.values(serverChanIds).forEach(m => Object.assign(wanted, m || {}));
  Object.keys(chatMetaWatch).forEach(id => {
    if(!wanted[id]){ chatMetaWatch[id].off(); delete chatMetaWatch[id]; delete chatsMetaCache[id]; delete chatMetaLoaded[id]; }
  });
  Object.keys(wanted).forEach(id => {
    if(chatMetaWatch[id]) return;
    const ref = db.ref('chatsMeta/' + id);
    chatMetaWatch[id] = ref;
    ref.on('value',
      s => { chatMetaLoaded[id] = true; if(s.exists()) chatsMetaCache[id] = s.val(); else delete chatsMetaCache[id]; onChatsMetaChanged(); },
      () => { chatMetaLoaded[id] = true; delete chatsMetaCache[id]; onChatsMetaChanged(); });
  });
  onChatsMetaChanged();
}

function reconcileServerWatchers(){
  Object.keys(serverWatch).forEach(id => {
    if(!myServerIds[id]){
      serverWatch[id].off(); serverChanWatch[id].off();
      delete serverWatch[id]; delete serverChanWatch[id]; delete serversCache[id]; delete serverChanIds[id];
    }
  });
  Object.keys(myServerIds).forEach(id => {
    if(serverWatch[id]) return;
    serverWatch[id] = db.ref('servers/' + id);
    serverWatch[id].on('value',
      s => { if(s.exists()) serversCache[id] = s.val(); else delete serversCache[id]; onServersChanged(); },
      () => { delete serversCache[id]; onServersChanged(); });
    serverChanWatch[id] = db.ref('serverChannels/' + id);
    serverChanWatch[id].on('value',
      s => { serverChanIds[id] = s.val() || {}; reconcileChatMetaWatchers(); },
      () => {});
  });
  reconcileChatMetaWatchers();
  onServersChanged();
}

function onChatsMetaChanged(){
  if(needInitialChat && chatsMetaCache[GENERAL_CHAT_ID]){ needInitialChat = false; openDefaultChat(); }
  else if(currentChatId && chatMetaLoaded[currentChatId] && !chatsMetaCache[currentChatId]) openDefaultChat();
  renderGroupsList();
  renderPublicChannelsList();
  if(currentChatId) updateCurrentChatLabel();
  updateHeaderCallButtons();
  reconcileVoiceWatchers();
  reconcileNotifyWatchers();
}

function onServersChanged(){
  if(currentServerId && !myServerIds[currentServerId]){
    currentServerId = null; updateSidebarForServer(); openDefaultChat();
  }
  updateSidebarForServer();
  renderGroupsList();
}

// voice participants are watched per chat (never a global listener)
function reconcileVoiceWatchers(){
  Object.keys(voiceWatch).forEach(id => {
    if(!chatsMetaCache[id]){ voiceWatch[id].ref.off('value', voiceWatch[id].cb); delete voiceWatch[id]; delete voiceParticipantsAllCache[id]; }
  });
  Object.keys(chatsMetaCache).forEach(id => {
    const m = chatsMetaCache[id];
    if(!m || m.type === 'dm' || voiceWatch[id]) return;
    const ref = db.ref('voiceChannels/' + id + '/participants');
    const cb = s => {
      voiceParticipantsAllCache[id] = s.val() || {};
      renderGroupsList(); renderPublicChannelsList();
      if(voiceState.chatId) renderVoiceChips();
      updateVoiceStatusBar();
    };
    voiceWatch[id] = { ref, cb };
    ref.on('value', cb, () => {});
  });
}

function stopAllWatchers(){
  [myChatIdsRef, myServerIdsRef, publicChatIdsRef].forEach(r => { if(r) r.off('value'); });
  myChatIdsRef = myServerIdsRef = publicChatIdsRef = null;
  Object.values(chatMetaWatch).forEach(r => r.off());
  Object.values(serverWatch).forEach(r => r.off());
  Object.values(serverChanWatch).forEach(r => r.off());
  Object.values(voiceWatch).forEach(w => w.ref.off('value', w.cb));
  Object.values(notifyWatch).forEach(w => w.ref.off('child_added', w.cb));
  notifyWatch = {}; unreadCache = {}; updateTitleBadge();
  if(pinnedRef){ pinnedRef.off('value'); pinnedRef = null; }
  chatMetaWatch = {}; chatMetaLoaded = {}; serverWatch = {}; serverChanWatch = {}; voiceWatch = {};
  myChatIds = {}; myServerIds = {}; publicChatIds = {}; serverChanIds = {};
}

/* =========================================================
   CHATS
========================================================= */
async function ensureGeneralChatExists(){
  try{
    const pc = await db.ref('publicChannels/' + GENERAL_CHAT_ID).get();
    if(pc.exists()) return;
    await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + GENERAL_CHAT_ID).set({ type:'public', name:'general', createdBy:'system', created: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP });
    await db.ref('publicChannels/' + GENERAL_CHAT_ID).set(true);
  }catch(err){ console.error('Could not create #general', err); }
}

function isMemberOf(meta){
  if(!meta) return false;
  if(meta.type === 'public') return true;
  if(meta.serverId){ const sv = serversCache[meta.serverId]; if(sv && sv.members && sv.members[myKey]) return true; }
  return !!(meta.members && meta.members[myKey]);
}
function canAccessChat(meta){ return isMemberOf(meta); }
function canManageChannel(meta){
  if(!meta) return false;
  if(meta.createdBy === myKey) return true;
  const sv = meta.serverId ? serversCache[meta.serverId] : null;
  if(sv && sv.createdBy === myKey) return true;
  if(isAdmin && meta.type === 'public') return true;
  return false;
}

/* ---------- invite codes ---------- */
function generateInviteCode(){
  const chars = 'ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789';
  let s = ''; for(let i=0;i<6;i++) s += chars[Math.floor(Math.random()*chars.length)];
  return s;
}
async function ensureInviteCode(chatId){
  const meta = chatsMetaCache[chatId];
  if(meta && meta.inviteCode) return meta.inviteCode;
  let code = generateInviteCode();
  for(let tries=0; tries<5; tries++){
    const taken = await db.ref('inviteCodes/' + code).get();
    if(!taken.exists()) break;
    code = generateInviteCode();
  }
  await db.ref('inviteCodes/' + code).set(chatId);
  await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + chatId + '/inviteCode').set(code);
  return code;
}
let inviteModalChatId = null;
async function openInviteModal(){
  if(!currentChatId) return;
  const meta = chatsMetaCache[currentChatId];
  if(!meta || meta.type !== 'group' || meta.serverId) return;
  inviteModalChatId = currentChatId; inviteModalServerId = null;
  document.getElementById('inviteErr').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('inviteErr').className = 'modal-err';
  document.getElementById('inviteCodeBox').textContent = '······';
  document.getElementById('inviteModal').classList.add('open');
  try{ document.getElementById('inviteCodeBox').textContent = await ensureInviteCode(currentChatId); }
  catch(err){ console.error(err); document.getElementById('inviteErr').textContent = 'Could not create a code: ' + (err.message || 'unknown error'); }
}
function closeInviteModal(){ document.getElementById('inviteModal').classList.remove('open'); inviteModalChatId = null; inviteModalServerId = null; }
function copyInviteCode(){
  const code = document.getElementById('inviteCodeBox').textContent.trim();
  const errEl = document.getElementById('inviteErr');
  if(!code || code.indexOf('·') === 0) return;
  const done = () => { errEl.className = 'modal-err ok'; errEl.textContent = 'Code copied.'; };
  if(navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText){
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(done).catch(() => { errEl.className = 'modal-err'; errEl.textContent = 'Copy failed — select the code and copy it manually.'; });
  } else { errEl.className = 'modal-err'; errEl.textContent = 'Select the code above and copy it manually.'; }
}
async function regenerateInviteCode(){
  const errEl = document.getElementById('inviteErr');
  errEl.className = 'modal-err';
  if(inviteModalServerId){
    const sv = serversCache[inviteModalServerId];
    if(!sv || sv.createdBy !== myKey){ errEl.textContent = 'Only the server owner can reset the code.'; return; }
    try{
      if(sv.inviteCode) await db.ref('serverInvites/' + sv.inviteCode).remove();
      await db.ref('servers/' + inviteModalServerId + '/inviteCode').remove();
      document.getElementById('inviteCodeBox').textContent = await ensureServerInvite(inviteModalServerId);
      errEl.className = 'modal-err ok'; errEl.textContent = 'New code created. The old one no longer works.';
    }catch(err){ console.error(err); errEl.textContent = 'Could not reset the code: ' + (err.message || 'unknown error'); }
    return;
  }
  if(!inviteModalChatId) return;
  const meta = chatsMetaCache[inviteModalChatId];
  if(!canManageChannel(meta)){ errEl.textContent = 'Only the channel creator can reset the code.'; return; }
  try{
    if(meta.inviteCode) await db.ref('inviteCodes/' + meta.inviteCode).remove();
    await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + inviteModalChatId + '/inviteCode').remove();
    document.getElementById('inviteCodeBox').textContent = await ensureInviteCode(inviteModalChatId);
    errEl.className = 'modal-err ok'; errEl.textContent = 'New code created. The old one no longer works.';
  }catch(err){ console.error(err); errEl.textContent = 'Could not reset the code: ' + (err.message || 'unknown error'); }
}

async function joinChannelByCode(){
  const input = document.getElementById('joinCodeInput');
  const msgEl = document.getElementById('joinCodeMsg');
  msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg';
  const code = input.value.trim().toUpperCase();
  if(!code){ msgEl.textContent = 'Paste an invite code first.'; return; }
  try{
    const snap = await db.ref('inviteCodes/' + code).get();
    if(!snap.exists()){ msgEl.textContent = 'That code does not match any channel.'; return; }
    const chatId = snap.val();
    // the code itself is the proof of invitation; the database rules check it
    await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + chatId + '/members/' + myKey).set(code);
    await db.ref('memberships/' + myKey + '/chats/' + chatId).set(true);
    input.value = '';
    msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg ok'; msgEl.textContent = 'Joined!';
    await waitFor(() => chatsMetaCache[chatId], 4000);
    openChat(chatId); closeSidebarMobile();
  }catch(err){ console.error(err); msgEl.textContent = 'Could not join: ' + (err.message || 'unknown error'); }
}

/* ---------- channel lists ---------- */
function renderPublicChannelsList(){
  const list = document.getElementById('publicChannelsList');
  if(!list) return;
  const gn = document.getElementById('generalNavBtn');
  if(gn) gn.style.display = chatsMetaCache[GENERAL_CHAT_ID] ? '' : 'none';
  const gu = document.getElementById('generalUnread'); if(gu) gu.innerHTML = unreadBadge(GENERAL_CHAT_ID);
  const ids = Object.keys(chatsMetaCache).filter(id => chatsMetaCache[id] && chatsMetaCache[id].type === 'public');
  ids.sort((a,b) => { if(a === GENERAL_CHAT_ID) return -1; if(b === GENERAL_CHAT_ID) return 1; return (chatsMetaCache[a].created||0) - (chatsMetaCache[b].created||0); });
  if(!ids.length){ list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-list-note">No public channels yet.</div>'; return; }
  list.innerHTML = ids.map(id => {
    const meta = chatsMetaCache[id];
    const voiceCount = Object.keys(voiceParticipantsAllCache[id] || {}).length;
    const manage = canManageChannel(meta);
    return `<div class="list-item ${id === currentChatId ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="openChatFromSidebar('${id}')">
      <span class="hash">#</span>
      <span class="item-name">${escapeHtml(meta.name || 'unnamed')}</span>${unreadBadge(id)}
      ${voiceCount ? `<span class="voice-count">🎙️${voiceCount}</span>` : ''}
      ${manage ? `<button class="mini-btn nick" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); renameChannel('${id}')" title="Rename channel">✏️</button>` : ''}
      ${manage ? `<button class="mini-btn del" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); deleteChannel('${id}')" title="Delete channel">✕</button>` : ''}
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}
function renderGroupsList(){
  const list = document.getElementById('groupsList');
  let ids = Object.keys(chatsMetaCache).filter(id => {
    const meta = chatsMetaCache[id];
    if(!meta || meta.type !== 'group') return false;
    if(!isMemberOf(meta)) return false;
    if(currentServerId) return meta.serverId === currentServerId;
    return !meta.serverId;
  });
  ids.sort((a,b) => (chatsMetaCache[a].created||0) - (chatsMetaCache[b].created||0));
  if(!ids.length){ list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-list-note">No channels yet. Create one, or join with an invite code.</div>'; return; }
  list.innerHTML = ids.map(id => {
    const meta = chatsMetaCache[id];
    const voiceCount = Object.keys(voiceParticipantsAllCache[id] || {}).length;
    const amMember = !!(meta.members && meta.members[myKey]);
    const inServer = !!meta.serverId;
    return `<div class="list-item ${id === currentChatId ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="openChatFromSidebar('${id}')">
      <span class="hash">#</span>
      <span class="item-name">${escapeHtml(meta.name || 'unnamed')}</span>${unreadBadge(id)}
      ${voiceCount ? `<span class="voice-count">🎙️${voiceCount}</span>` : ''}
      ${inServer ? '' : `<button class="mini-btn addppl" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); openAddMemberFor('${id}')" title="Add people">＋</button>`}
      ${canManageChannel(meta) ? `<button class="mini-btn nick" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); renameChannel('${id}')" title="Rename channel">✏️</button>` : ''}
      ${inServer ? '' : `<button class="mini-btn invite" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); openInviteFor('${id}')" title="Invite code">🔗</button>`}
      ${(amMember && !inServer) ? `<button class="mini-btn leave" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); leaveChannel('${id}')" title="Leave channel">🚪</button>` : ''}
      ${canManageChannel(meta) ? `<button class="mini-btn del" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); deleteChannel('${id}')" title="Delete channel">✕</button>` : ''}
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}
function openChatFromSidebar(chatId){ openChat(chatId); closeSidebarMobile(); }
function openInviteFor(chatId){ openChat(chatId); setTimeout(openInviteModal, 30); }
function openAddMemberFor(chatId){ openChat(chatId); setTimeout(openAddMemberModal, 30); }
function openGeneralChat(){ openDefaultChat(); }
function openDefaultChat(){
  if(chatsMetaCache[GENERAL_CHAT_ID]){ openChat(GENERAL_CHAT_ID); return; }
  const firstPublic = Object.keys(chatsMetaCache).find(id => chatsMetaCache[id] && chatsMetaCache[id].type === 'public');
  if(firstPublic) openChat(firstPublic); else clearChatView();
}
function openFriendDm(friendKey){
  if(!friendsCache[friendKey]) return;
  const id = dmChatId(myKey, friendKey);
  ensureDmChatExists(id, friendKey).then(() => { openChat(id); closeSidebarMobile(); });
}
async function ensureDmChatExists(chatId, friendKey){
  if(myChatIds[chatId] && chatsMetaCache[chatId]) return;
  try{
    await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + chatId).set({ type:'dm', members:{ [myKey]:true, [friendKey]:true }, created: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP });
  }catch(err){ /* already exists — fine */ }
  try{
    await db.ref('memberships/' + myKey + '/chats/' + chatId).set(true);
    await db.ref('memberships/' + friendKey + '/chats/' + chatId).set(true);
  }catch(err){ console.error('Could not index DM', err); }
}

function openChat(chatId){
  const _meta = chatsMetaCache[chatId];
  if(_meta && !canAccessChat(_meta)){ clearChatView(); return; }
  currentChatId = chatId;
  currentChatMeta = chatsMetaCache[chatId] || null;
  currentMessagesList = [];
  delete unreadCache[chatId]; updateTitleBadge();
  closeSearch();
  document.getElementById('generalNavBtn').classList.toggle('active', chatId === GENERAL_CHAT_ID);
  renderFriendsList(); renderGroupsList(); renderPublicChannelsList(); renderServerRail();
  updateCurrentChatLabel(); updateHeaderCallButtons(); updateVoicePanelVisibility(); updateComposerState();
  startMessageListener(); startTypingListener();
}
function clearChatView(){
  stopMessageListener(); stopTypingListener();
  currentChatId = null; currentChatMeta = null; currentMessagesList = [];
  document.getElementById('currentChatLabel').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('currentChatSub').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('messages').innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span class="glyph">👥</span>Pick a channel or a friend to begin.</div>';
  updateHeaderCallButtons(); updateVoicePanelVisibility(); renderServerRail();
}
function updateCurrentChatLabel(){
  const meta = chatsMetaCache[currentChatId] || currentChatMeta;
  currentChatMeta = meta || currentChatMeta;
  const label = document.getElementById('currentChatLabel');
  const sub = document.getElementById('currentChatSub');
  if(!meta){ label.textContent=''; sub.textContent=''; return; }
  if(meta.type === 'public'){
    label.textContent = '# ' + (meta.name || 'general');
    sub.textContent = 'Public channel — everyone can see and post here';
  } else if(meta.type === 'dm'){
    const otherKey = Object.keys(meta.members || {}).find(k => k !== myKey);
    label.textContent = '@' + displayNameFor(friendsCache[otherKey] || (otherKey || ''));
    sub.textContent = isOnline(otherKey) ? 'Online' : 'Offline';
  } else {
    label.textContent = '#' + (meta.name || 'unnamed');
    const sv = meta.serverId ? serversCache[meta.serverId] : null;
    if(sv){ sub.textContent = (sv.name || 'Server') + ' · private server'; }
    else { const n = Object.keys(meta.members || {}).length; sub.textContent = n + (n === 1 ? ' member' : ' members') + ' · anyone here can invite'; }
  }
}
function currentDmFriendKey(){
  if(!currentChatMeta || currentChatMeta.type !== 'dm') return null;
  return Object.keys(currentChatMeta.members || {}).find(k => k !== myKey) || null;
}
function updateHeaderCallButtons(){
  const friendKey = currentDmFriendKey();
  const showCall = !!friendKey && !!friendsCache[friendKey];
  document.getElementById('headerCallAudioBtn').style.display = showCall ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('headerCallVideoBtn').style.display = showCall ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
  const meta = chatsMetaCache[currentChatId] || currentChatMeta;
  const isGroup = !!meta && meta.type === 'group';
  const isPublic = !!meta && meta.type === 'public';
  const inServer = isGroup && !!meta.serverId;
  const amMember = isGroup && !inServer && !!(meta.members && meta.members[myKey]);
  const manage = canManageChannel(meta);
  document.getElementById('headerAddPeopleBtn').style.display = (isGroup && !inServer) ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('headerRenameBtn').style.display = ((isGroup || isPublic) && manage) ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('headerInviteBtn').style.display = (isGroup && !inServer) ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('headerLeaveBtn').style.display = amMember ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
  updateMuteButtons();
}
function startCallWithCurrentFriend(type){
  const friendKey = currentDmFriendKey();
  if(!friendKey || !friendsCache[friendKey]) return;
  startCall(friendKey, friendsCache[friendKey], type);
}

/* =========================================================
   SERVERS — private, member-only, customizable
========================================================= */
function shade(hex, amt){
  const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
  const c = [(n>>16)+amt, ((n>>8)&255)+amt, (n&255)+amt].map(v => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, v)));
  return '#' + ((1<<24) + (c[0]<<16) + (c[1]<<8) + c[2]).toString(16).slice(1);
}
function applyServerTheme(sv){
  const c = (sv && /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(sv.color || '')) ? sv.color : '#5865f2';
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--blurple', c);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--blurple-hover', shade(c, -24));
}

function renderServerRail(){
  const list = document.getElementById('serverRailList');
  const home = document.getElementById('railHome');
  if(!list || !home) return;
  home.classList.toggle('active', !currentServerId);
  const ids = Object.keys(serversCache)
    .filter(id => serversCache[id] && serversCache[id].members && serversCache[id].members[myKey])
    .sort((a,b) => (serversCache[a].created||0) - (serversCache[b].created||0));
  list.innerHTML = ids.map(id => {
    const sv = serversCache[id];
    const safeIcon = sv.icon || null;
    const inner = safeIcon
      ? `<img src="${escapeHtml(safeIcon)}" alt="" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;">`
      : escapeHtml(sv.emoji || (sv.name || '?').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase() || '?');
    const un = Object.keys(chatsMetaCache).filter(c => chatsMetaCache[c] && chatsMetaCache[c].serverId === id).reduce((n, c) => n + (unreadCache[c] || 0), 0);
    return `<div class="rail-icon ${id === currentServerId ? 'active' : ''}" title="${escapeHtml(sv.name || 'server')}" onclick="selectServer('${id}')">${inner}${un ? `<span class="rail-badge">${un > 99 ? '99+' : un}</span>` : ''}</div>`;
  }).join('');
  renderPinnedRail();
}
function updateSidebarForServer(){
  const sv = currentServerId ? serversCache[currentServerId] : null;
  document.getElementById('publicChannelsBlock').style.display = sv ? 'none' : 'block';
  document.getElementById('channelsTitle').textContent = sv ? 'Server Channels' : 'Your Channels';
  document.getElementById('serverActions').style.display = sv ? 'block' : 'none';
  const del = document.getElementById('deleteServerBtn');
  if(del) del.style.display = (sv && sv.createdBy === myKey) ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
  applyServerTheme(sv);
  updateMuteButtons();
  renderServerMembers();
  const desc = document.getElementById('chanColDesc');
  desc.textContent = (sv && sv.description) ? sv.description : '';
  desc.style.display = (sv && sv.description) ? 'block' : 'none';
  const ban = document.getElementById('chanColBanner');
  const head = document.getElementById('chanColHeader');
  if(sv){
    const accent = /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i.test(sv.color || '') ? sv.color : '#5865f2';
    const bUrl = sv.banner || null;
    ban.style.display = 'flex';
    ban.style.backgroundImage = bUrl
      ? 'linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0) 35%, rgba(0,0,0,.7)), url("' + bUrl.replace(/"/g, '%22') + '")'
      : 'linear-gradient(135deg, ' + accent + ', ' + shade(accent, -70) + ')';
    ban.innerHTML = '<span class="banner-name">' + escapeHtml((sv.emoji ? sv.emoji + ' ' : '') + (sv.name || 'Server')) + '</span>';
    head.style.display = '';
  } else {
    ban.style.display = 'none'; ban.innerHTML = ''; ban.style.backgroundImage = '';
    head.style.display = '';
  }

function goHome(){
  currentServerId = null;
  updateSidebarForServer(); renderGroupsList(); openDefaultChat();
}
function selectServer(id, preferChatId){
  const sv = serversCache[id];
  if(!sv || !(sv.members && sv.members[myKey])) return;
  currentServerId = id;
  updateSidebarForServer(); switchSidebarTab('groups'); renderGroupsList();
  let chatId = preferChatId;
  if(!chatId){
    const ids = Object.keys(chatsMetaCache).filter(c => chatsMetaCache[c] && chatsMetaCache[c].serverId === id)
      .sort((a,b) => (chatsMetaCache[a].created||0) - (chatsMetaCache[b].created||0));
    chatId = ids[0];
  }
  if(chatId) openChat(chatId); else clearChatView();
}
function openServerModal(){
  document.getElementById('newServerName').value = '';
  document.getElementById('joinServerCode').value = '';
  document.getElementById('serverErr').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('serverErr').className = 'modal-err';
  document.getElementById('serverModal').classList.add('open');
  setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('newServerName').focus(), 50);
}
function closeServerModal(){ document.getElementById('serverModal').classList.remove('open'); }

async function ensureServerInvite(serverId){
  const sv = serversCache[serverId];
  if(sv && sv.inviteCode) return sv.inviteCode;
  let code = generateInviteCode();
  for(let tries=0; tries<5; tries++){
    const taken = await db.ref('serverInvites/' + code).get();
    if(!taken.exists()) break;
    code = generateInviteCode();
  }
  await db.ref('serverInvites/' + code).set(serverId);
  await db.ref('servers/' + serverId + '/inviteCode').set(code);
  return code;
}

async function createServer(){
  const errEl = document.getElementById('serverErr');
  errEl.className = 'modal-err';
  const name = document.getElementById('newServerName').value.trim();
  if(!name){ errEl.textContent = 'Give the server a name.'; return; }
  if(!nameIsClean(name)){ errEl.textContent = "That server name isn't allowed."; return; }
  try{
    const TS = firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP;
    const srvRef = db.ref('servers').push();
    await srvRef.set({ name, createdBy: myKey, members: { [myKey]: true }, created: TS });
    const chRef = db.ref('chatsMeta').push();
    await chRef.set({ type:'group', name:'general', serverId: srvRef.key, members: { [myKey]: true }, createdBy: myKey, created: TS });
    await db.ref('serverChannels/' + srvRef.key + '/' + chRef.key).set(true);
    await db.ref('memberships/' + myKey + '/servers/' + srvRef.key).set(true);
    await ensureServerInvite(srvRef.key);
    closeServerModal();
    await waitFor(() => serversCache[srvRef.key] && chatsMetaCache[chRef.key], 4000);
    selectServer(srvRef.key, chRef.key);
  }catch(err){ console.error(err); errEl.textContent = 'Could not create server: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'unknown error'); }
}

async function joinServerByCode(){
  const errEl = document.getElementById('serverErr');
  errEl.className = 'modal-err';
  const code = document.getElementById('joinServerCode').value.trim().toUpperCase();
  if(!code){ errEl.textContent = 'Paste an invite code first.'; return; }
  try{
    const snap = await db.ref('serverInvites/' + code).get();
    if(!snap.exists()){ errEl.textContent = 'That code does not match any server.'; return; }
    const id = snap.val();
    await db.ref('servers/' + id + '/members/' + myKey).set(code);   // the code is the proof of invitation
    await db.ref('memberships/' + myKey + '/servers/' + id).set(true);
    closeServerModal();
    await waitFor(() => serversCache[id] && Object.keys(serverChanIds[id] || {}).some(c => chatsMetaCache[c]), 4000);
    selectServer(id);
  }catch(err){ console.error(err); errEl.textContent = 'Could not join: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'unknown error'); }
}

async function openServerInvite(){
  if(!currentServerId) return;
  inviteModalChatId = null; inviteModalServerId = currentServerId;
  document.getElementById('inviteErr').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('inviteErr').className = 'modal-err';
  document.getElementById('inviteCodeBox').textContent = '······';
  document.getElementById('inviteModal').classList.add('open');
  try{ document.getElementById('inviteCodeBox').textContent = await ensureServerInvite(currentServerId); }
  catch(err){ console.error(err); document.getElementById('inviteErr').textContent = 'Could not create a code: ' + (err.message || 'unknown error'); }
}
async function leaveCurrentServer(){
  const id = currentServerId, sv = serversCache[id];
  if(!sv) return;
  if(!confirm('Leave "' + (sv.name || 'this server') + '"? You can rejoin with an invite code.')) return;
  try{
    await db.ref('servers/' + id + '/members/' + myKey).remove();
    await db.ref('memberships/' + myKey + '/servers/' + id).remove();
    goHome();
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to leave server', err); }
}
async function deleteCurrentServer(){
  const id = currentServerId, sv = serversCache[id];
  if(!sv) return;
  if(sv.createdBy !== myKey){ alert('Only the server owner can delete this.'); return; }
  if(!confirm('Delete server "' + (sv.name || id) + '" and ALL its channels and messages? This cannot be undone.')) return;
  try{
    for(const c of Object.keys(serverChanIds[id] || {})){
      const m = chatsMetaCache[c];
      await db.ref('chatsMsgs/' + c).remove();
      await db.ref('voiceChannels/' + c).remove();
      if(m && m.inviteCode) await db.ref('inviteCodes/' + m.inviteCode).remove();
      await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + c).remove();
    }
    await db.ref('serverChannels/' + id).remove();
    for(const k of Object.keys(sv.members || {})) await db.ref('memberships/' + k + '/servers/' + id).remove().catch(()=>{});
    if(sv.inviteCode) await db.ref('serverInvites/' + sv.inviteCode).remove();
    await db.ref('servers/' + id).remove();
    goHome();
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to delete server', err); alert('Could not delete server: ' + err.message); }
}

function renderServerMembersList(){
  const sv = serversCache[serverSettingsId];
  const list = document.getElementById('serverMembersList');
  if(!sv){ list.innerHTML = ''; return; }
  const isOwner = sv.createdBy === myKey;

    return `<div class="member-row"><span>${escapeHtml(displayNameFor(name))}${own}</span>${kick}</div>`;
  }).join('');
